## Drop quantity
Affects the quantity of items dropped (all types)
Each Base affix increases drop quantity bonus by a certain value. Drop quantity increases with the number and danger of the Base affixes.
## Drop quantity
The Drop Quantity bonus affects the quantity of base items dropped.
The Drop Quantity bonus affects the quantity of base items dropped.

The Drop Quantity bonus and additional Drop Quantity bonus do not apply to all items dropped. Refer to the corresponding gameplay for details on which items are not affected by these bonuses (such as items obtained from Cubes of Rapacity, Dream Bubbles, Chests of Folklores, Splendor Eggs, etc.)
Calculation

Final expected Drop Quantity = Original expected Drop Quantity x (1 + Drop Quantity bonus 1 + Drop Quantity bonus 2 + Drop Quantity bonus 3 +...) x (1 + additional Drop Quantity bonus 1) x (1 + additional Drop Quantity bonus 2) x (1 + additional Drop Quantity bonus 3) x...
Note: The Drop Quantity does not affect the weight distribution of each item in the drop library.
The following are examples of drops in different situations:
Example 1: If a drop has a 100% chance to drop 1 item, and the item has a 100% chance to be a Flame Elementium, then with "+100% Drop Quantity," there is a 100% chance to drop 2 Flame Elementium.

Example 2: If a drop has a 100% chance to drop 1 item, and the item has a 100% chance to be a Flame Elementium, then with "+100% Drop Quantity" and "+100% additional Drop Quantity," there is a 100% chance to drop 4 Flame Elementium.

Example 3: If a drop has a 50% chance to drop 1 item, and the item has a 100% chance to be a Flame Elementium, then with "+100% Drop Quantity," there is a 25% chance to drop no items, 50% chance to drop 1 Flame Elementium, and 25% to drop 2 Flame Elementium.

Example 4: If a drop has a 50% chance to drop 1 item, and the item has a 50% chance to be a Flame Elementium and a 50% chance to be a Flame Sand, then with "+100% Drop Quantity," there is a 25% chance to drop no items, 25% chance to drop 1 Flame Elementium, 25% chance to drop 1 Flame Sand, 6.25% chance to drop 2 Flame Elementium, 6.25% to drop 2 Flame Sand, and 12.5% chance to drop 1 Flame Elementium and 1 Flame Sand.

Example 5: If a drop has a 100% chance to drop 1 item, and the item has a 100% chance to be a Flame Elementium, then with "-50% Drop Quantity," there is a 50% chance to drop no items and a 50% chance to drop 1 Flame Elementium.

name: Dwarf King
text: ## Dwarf King - Codex
I sneaked into the group that was going to meet the Dwarf King, just to see that young king reveling in the attention of being surrounded by thousands.

But he is blind. I mean, he has been blinded by the glory of the ancient dwarves and the flames of desire ignited by the Spark, and thus he cannot see what is occurring right by his side. He speaks of the Dwarven Kingdom's future, yet he exhausts its present.

I think it's time to put an end to my journey. After reading through what my ancestors left to the world, I have fully understood the history of the Epoch of Might. Maybe I will write it all down in the near future.

I have translated my ancestors' words into the common tongue of this land. I may have altered the style a little, but the content has remained mostly unchanged. I hope one day someone will find out those words from my journal. The sacrifice of heroes must be remembered by the world.
Albert's Notes

## Calibrate Prism - Help
Calibrate Prisms to add random affixes to Ethereal Prisms.

Calibration generates 3 random optional affixes, 1 of which is selected as the final result. Each Prism slot can be calibrated to produce a corresponding type of affix. Slot 1 can be calibrated with a Prism Effect Area affix. Slot 2 can be calibrated with a Prism Additional Effect Affix. Slot 3 can be calibrated with a Prism Legendary Mechanic Affix.
During calibration, a special additional material called Prism Level can be added. Its function is to make it possible to manually refresh the random affix options once.
Prisms that already have 1 or more random affixes can be restored using the restoration feature by spending certain materials. Prisms that have reached the Plasticity upper limit cannot be restored.

name: Evade
text: ## Evade
Evade is a defensive mechanic against Hit Damage.
When a hit is evaded, on-hit effects and damage will not be inflicted. Evade Chance is determined by the attacker's Accuracy and the defender's Evasion.
Monsters can't evade hits.
Players have 0 Evasion by default. The lower limit of Evasion is 0.
Evasion increased by 2 for every level gained.
The upper limit of Evade Chance is 75%%.
By default, Evasion will additionally reduce 40%% Spell Damage.
Your Evasion Chance for incoming Hit Damage is calculated using the following formula:
Your Evasion Chance = 1 - [(Enemy Accuracy x 1.15) / (Enemy Accuracy + 0.5 x Your Evasion ^ 0.75)]
Enemy Accuracy in the formula increases with the enemy's level, ranging from 130 to 680.

Fluorescent Memories may drop while challenging Netherrealm. After collecting the required number of Fluorescent Memories, you can exchange them for needed items at the Trader.
Boss monsters have different Fluorescent Memory drop rates in each Netherrealm map. You can check these rates before entering the map.

Focus Skills are Passive Skills that provide various damage-enhancing effects. Focus Pts are gained by meeting certain conditions. Additional skill effects can be triggered at max Focus Pts.
Focus Effect
The positive effect values provided by Focus Skills are affected by Focus Effect bonuses, but the triggered skill effects are not affected.
Positive effect value = Base value x (1 + all non-additional bonus percentages) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 1) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 2)...
Focus Pts

Focus Speed
Focus Pts gained are affected by Focus Speed bonuses.
Focus Pts = Base value x (1 + all non-additional bonus percentages) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 1) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 2)...
Focus Damage Enhancement
Focus Damage Enhancement additionally increases the damage and Ailment Damage dealt by Focus Skills, and the values of each Enhancement affix are stacked together.
For example: When you have 2 "+50% Focus Damage Enhancement" affixes, the actual effect is +100% additional damage dealt by Focus Skills.

name: Folklores
text: ## Folklores
Defeat Mistville "Residents" to get their eyes, which can be used to gain Infection Progress.
Dispel the mist at the cost of your Sanity and find the Clock Tower to start a new day.
Challenge Advent of Folklores to obtain Chests of Folklores.
Infection Progress

Mistville "Residents" will appear in the stage when "there are Mistville 'Residents' paying you a visit in this stage." Defeat them to get their eyes, which can be used to gain Infection Progress. You will be able to visit Mistville upon reaching a certain Infection Progress.
Mistville Exploration

After entering Mistville, you will interact with a Lantern to start your exploration, during which you must dispel the mist at the cost of your Sanity and find the Clock Tower to start a new day. When your Sanity has been exhausted or you have survived 15 days, the current round will be over.
Advent of Folklores
On odd-numbered days. You can interact with the Clock Tower to enter the Advent of Folklores gameplay. Completing an Advent of Folklore will allow you to get rewards from a Chest of Folklores.

name: Frostbite and Freeze
text: ## Frostbite and Freeze
A control Ailment that generally has a chance to be inflicted by Cold Damage on hit: Frostbite can Slow the target and make them take more damage. Targets are Frozen at 100 Frostbite Rating.
Frostbite
By default, all Cold Damage has a 0% chance of inflicting Frostbite.
Frostbite reduces the Attack, Cast, and Movement Speed of the target by 10%, and deals additional Cold Damage to them based on their Frostbite Rating.
Frostbite Rating
Frostbitten enemies have 10 points of Frostbite Rating by default. The Max Frostbite Rating is 120.
Units only have Frostbite Rating when they are Frostbitten.
Freeze
When a unit has more than 100 Frostbite Rating, the unit will be Frozen.
Freeze ends when Frostbite ends.
Frozen Non-Boss enemies will be Frost-Sealed periodically. Frost-Sealed enemies cannot act. The base duration of Frost-Seal is 1s, and the Frost-Sealed Interval is 3s for the same enemy.

Frosted is a special Frostbite status.

name: Gameplay
text: ## Gameplay - Chest Mimic - Help
Mystery Chest events may appear in any Netherrealm stage.
Be careful though, as it might be a Chest Mimic pretending to be something else!
The mode has a chance to drop exclusive Legendary gear: Ice Breaker, Loner's Boots, Windbreath Convergence, and False God's Skin.
## Gameplay - Trial: God of War - Help
In any Netherrealm stage, you may find 1 Trial: God of War.
Defeat as many monsters as you can before the timer runs out to gain reward levels as well as acquiring more time.
The gameplay has a chance to drop exclusive Legendary gear: Crimson King, Ghost Slaughter, Furious Heart, and Dragon Breath Armor.
## Gameplay - Trial: God of Might - Help
In any Netherrealm stage, you may find 1 Trial: God of Might.
The longer you survive in this trial, the more abundant your rewards will be.
The mode has a chance to drop exclusive Legendary gear: Forlorn Crystal, Polygonal Enclosure, Last Words of Chaos, and Divine Ember.
## Gameplay - Trial: God of Machines - Help

In any Netherrealm stage, you may find 1 Trial: God of Machines. Defeat as many monsters as you can while protecting the mechanical core. The more waves of monsters you defeat to protect the mechanical core, the more abundant your rewards will be.
The mode has a chance to drop exclusive Legendary gear: Surging Inspiration, Mistaken Authority, Decayed Mind, and Necklace of Firebird.
## Gameplay - Trial: Goddess of Hunting - Help
In any Netherrealm stage, you may find 1 Trial: Goddess of Hunting.

Select the blessing and test you would like to receive from the Goddess of Hunting, then challenge and defeat the Netherrealm Boss. The higher the trial Rarity you selected, the more abundant your rewards will be.
The mode has a chance to drop exclusive Legendary gear: Thunder Jawbone, Shadow of Thunderlight's Footsteps, Skin of Malice, and Starlit Body.

## Gear - Item Level - Help
As you progress through the story, the level of maps will increase.
In higher-level maps, you'll find gear with higher item levels.
Gear with a higher item level is more likely to receive rare affixes via crafting.
## Gear - Affix Tier - Help
Each affix on gear is assigned a level that can be inspected in the gear details. Affix levels are related to the item level. For every 10 levels, a higher grade of affixes is unlocked.
The higher the affix tier, the stronger the effects.
## Gear - Energy - Help
Energy is one of the base gear stats. It only appears on items with a sufficient item level.
Weapons and Chest Armor usually provide more Energy than other items while trinkets don't have Energy.
## Gear - Legendary Gear Rarity - Help

Legendary gear is categorized into various rarities: Common Legendary gear, Fine Legendary gear, Precious Legendary gear, Matchless Legendary gear, and Ultimate Legendary gear. These rarities will be visually indicated by drop frames with distinct colors.

## Graft
Customizes Random Affixes of Vorax Gear.
Grafting can be performed on Vorax Gear at [Mad Doctor Shelley] in the Town to customize random affixes on gear.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear.
Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Vorax Gear.
Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear. The Core Organs of some Legendary gear can only be Grafted to high-level Vorax Gear.
During Grafting, affix options will be provided based on the number of affixes on the corresponding Legendary gear.
The Legendary affixes of a Vorax Gear must come from the same Legendary gear.
Legendary gear with 2 affixes provides 1 affix option, while Legendary gear with more than 2 affixes provides 2 affix options.
Each piece of Vorax Gear can have up to 2 Advanced affixes, 2 Ultimate affixes, and 2 Legendary affixes.
Use Cutting Instruments to re-roll the values of all random affixes of Vorax Gear.
When a piece of Vorax Gear already has a certain Ultimate affix, the corresponding Special Organ can't be Grafted on it again.
When Grafting with some Special Organs there is a chance for a Blemish to appear.
When a piece of Vorax Gear has 2 Legendary affixes, Core Organs can no longer be Grafted onto it.
## Graft - Help
The Grafting system allows you to add affixes to Vorax Gear.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear.
Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Lv. 89 or above Vorax Gear.

Each piece of Vorax Gear can have up to 2 Advanced affixes, 2 Ultimate affixes, and 2 Legendary affixes.
Use Cutting Instruments to re-roll the values of all random affixes of Vorax Gear.
You can equip only 1 piece of Vorax Gear at a time.

name: Hero
text: ## Hero /28

Berserker Rehan | Anger: Rehan will gain Rage upon hitting a target or taking damage and then gain damage from Rage. At Max Rage, Rehan will automatically enter the Berserk state and have his stats significantly increased.

Berserker Rehan | Seething Silhouette: Blessed by the Ancestor Spirit, Rehan has a chance to summon the Seething Spirit to assist him in fights. The Seething Spirit will cast the Main Skill to help Rehan fight powerful enemies.

Divineshot Carino | Ranger of Glory: Carino is a character specialized in projectiles' special ammo. When using Projectile Skills, Carino will use different special ammo combos to assist in firing and enhance the skills at the cost of ammo.
Divineshot Carino | Lethal Flash: Lethal Flash centers around controlling projectile range. It changes projectile forms to match the situation, and boosts damage and survivability through Deflection.

Divineshot Carino | Zealot of War: Carino's combat style revolves around switching shooting modes and managing heat. Carino can change modes on the fly to adapt to various situations and gain a high damage bonus by consuming ammo. However, he'll also be forced to reload when his muzzle overheats.

Cateye Erika | Wind Stalker: During combat, Erika can dodge attacks and launch a powerful strike through her swift movements and agile positioning. After moving a certain distance, Erika will gain Stalker, move even faster, have a higher chance to Multistrike, and deal more damage.
Cateye Erika | Lightning Shadow: Utilizes lightning-powered Ember Tech to gain massive buffs. · Inflicts Numbed on the enemies within range through Feline Figure and effectively increases damage.
Cateye Erika|Vendetta's Sting: Transformed into an assassin, Erika darts swiftly through enemy lines, unleashing a flurry of swift and deadly melee strikes.

Escapist Bing | Blast Nova: Bing can pack a large number of projectiles into his exquisite and dangerous bombs, dealing deadly damage by throwing multiple bombs at once and detonating them in an instant.

Escapist Bing | Creative Genius: Bing carries two Inspiration Machines, charging them with Whimsy Essence and Ingenuity Essence. He uses Whimsy Explosion to increase Spell Damage taken by enemies and Ingenuity Overload to unleash devastating Spell Bursts!
Frostfire Gemma | Flame of Pleasure: Casts Purgatory, greatly weakening enemies within it and increasing your damage dealt.

Frostfire Gemma | Frostbitten Heart: When using Cold Skills, Gemma will gain Cold Energy, which will increase Cold Damage and Frostbite Chance. At Max Cold Energy, Gemma will cast Cold Pulse and deal massive Cold Damage.

Frostfire Gemma | Ice-Fire Fusion: The forces of fire and ice fuse within Gemma's body, reinforcing each other. When using Cold and Fire Skills, Gemma will gain Fusion Energy. At Max Fusion Energy, Gemma can cast Frostfire Rampage to increase her damage.

Oracle Thea | Wisdom of The Gods: Thea is capable of gaining and using Tenacity, Focus, and Agility Blessings skillfully. She can enhance the incoming God's Boon and gain buffs at the cost of Blessings.

Oracle Thea | Incarnation of The Gods: Thea can use blessings to summon a Divine Realm in the mortal world. When outside the Divine Realm, Thea can fight against enemies with the Agility Blessing. When inside the Divine Realm, she will fight against powerful enemies with the Tenacity Blessing.
Oracle Thea | Blasphemer: Thea can convert Blessings into a sacrilegious power that increases the Erosion Damage dealt to a single enemy and can cause Erosion Explosions with a large area of effect.

Spacetime Witness Youga | Spacetime Illusion: Youga can create a Twisted Spacetime around himself to gain multiple buffs when staying inside it. When in the Twisted Spacetime, he can summon a shadow who can cast skills independently to assist him.

Spacetime Witness Youga | Spacetime Elapse: When encountering enemies, Youga releases the Twisted Spacetime and deals Damage Over Time to them. When he moves the Twisted Spacetime, it applies Spacetime Turbulence on enemies within it, speeding up and enhancing Damage Over Time.

Spacetime Witness Youga | The Ultimate One: Don't bother with the others. The most perfect "me" is right before your eyes. I can fill the Clockwork Core with Spell Tangle, and with a snap of my fingers, magic pours out on its own. Land a few Critical Strikes, and my Cooldowns melt away. I slip through time and space at will, turning certain defeat into victory. I dominate. I conquer. I reign. I am the final master of countless worlds and ages.

Commander Moto | Order Calling: Moto is capable of leading his Synthetic Troop to fight. He will inflict Overload on Minions frequently to increase their Life, Speed, Attack, and other stats to let this iron army fight for him.

Commander Moto | Charge Calling: Moto commands the Synthetic Troop to dash toward enemies and makes them self-destruct. When in combat, Moto can use Overload to quickly summon Synthetic Troops to increase the explosion efficiency and enhance combat capability.
Lightbringer Rosa | High Court Chariot: You can use Holy Domain to force enemies to gather together and gain buffs when you're in the Holy Domain.
Lightbringer Rosa | Unsullied Blade: Increase your Mana to deal lots of Elemental Damage to enemies inside the Realm of Mercury.
The Forsaken Iris | Growing Breeze: Fight with Spirit Magi and give them buffs to speed up their growth.

The Forsaken Iris | Vigilant Breeze: Iris merges with a Spirit Magus to enter the Vigilant state, fighting enemies with Spirit Magus Skills and granting Spirit Magi with Breeze to enhance their damage.

Tide Whisper Selena | Sing with the Tide: In Bard form, you can encase skills in bubbles while moving. When a bubble bursts, the skill within is cast at that location, creating a Tide. In Loud Song form, you can deal significantly increased damage when standing in the Tide.

Tide Whisper: Selena | Dance of the Deep: Makes Terra Skills follow you as you move. Dance with them to gain multiple Terra Skill-related bonuses and auto-use your Main Terra Skill. Different Dance Steps also grant Movement Speed, Survival, and Damage buffs.

Scent Weaver Sage|Licorice Note: Sage is a master of alchemy capable of brewing potent Elixirs to unlock her potential and take down even the most formidable foes. In battle, she can adapt her recipes on the fly, mixing special Elixirs to provide versatile support.

Click the icon of a hero trait to activate its special ability.

name: Hero Ranking
text: ## Hero Ranking
You can refer to the builds of the excellent Hunters from the Hero Ranking.
You can access Hero Ranking through the menu.
In Hero Ranking, you can select a character to check their skills, Talents, gear, and other information.
You can also narrow down your search by selecting specific heroes, skills, and gear to better find the character information you are looking for.
## Hero Ranking - Help
The hero ranking reflects how players choose to make use of the heroes and schools. Draw inspirations and construct your school.

name: Hero Trait
text: ## Hero Trait - Help
Hero Traits define a hero's combat style. You may select different Trait branches once you meet the level requirements.
Click the icon of a hero trait to activate its special ability.

## Horizontal
Horizontal Skills generally launch Projectiles with a horizontal trajectory.
Horizontal Skills generally launch Projectiles with a horizontal trajectory. Projectiles can deal damage to the same enemy more than once with an interval of 0.25s.
Projectile Quantity

The Projectile Quantity of Horizontal Skills is affected by Quantity bonuses. The firing location of the additional Projectiles is the same as the original Projectile. Projectiles are fired at intervals at a certain angle.
Penetrate
After a Projectile fired by a Horizontal Skill hits an enemy, if it has remaining Penetrations, it will continue flying through the enemy and consume 1 Penetration.
Jump

After a Projectile fired by a Horizontal Skill hits an enemy, if it has remaining Jumps, it will continue to fly toward another enemy within a certain area and consume 1 Jump. The radius of a Projectile's Jump Area is 12m.
Projectiles will not target units they have already Jumped off.
Return

When a Projectile fired by a Horizontal Skill vanishes, if the Projectile has the Return trait, it flies back to the player instead of vanishing until its flight duration ends or it reaches the player.
The Penetrations and Jumps of Returning Projectiles will be reset.
Priority of Penetrate, Jump, and Return
When a Projectile has Penetrate, Jump and Return, only one effect will be triggered each time according to the following priority: Penetrate > Jump > Return.

name: Hot Streak
text: ## Hot Streak - Help
Hot Streak provides the following 6 high-risk high-reward mechanics.
1. Re-roll Gear Energy
Use TOWER Tokens - Energy to re-roll the Energy of a piece of gear. If it is successful, the gear's Energy will be increased to the maximum. If it fails, the Energy will remain unchanged.
2. Re-roll All Pre-fix and Suffix Values of Non-Legendary Gear, Granting Luckier Results.

Use TOWER Tokens - Affix and Truth Fossils to re-roll all pre-fix and suffix values of a piece of non-Legendary gear. A random percentage between 0 and 100% will be selected, and all pre-fix and suffix values on the gear will be scaled by the percentage (rounded to the nearest).
For example, if the rolled percentage is 100%, all pre-fix and suffix values on the gear will be adjusted to the maximum value within the range (known as a max roll).
3. Re-roll Base Affixes of Priceless Gear

Use TOWER Tokens - Priceless to re-roll the Base affixes of a piece of Priceless gear. If it is successful, all the Base affixes of the gear will be re-rolled (The number of re-rolled Base affixes equals the current number of Base affixes). If it fails, one Base affix will be removed.
4. Re-roll Corrosion Base Affixes of Corroded Legendary Gear

Use TOWER Tokens - Corrosion to re-roll the Corrosion Base affixes of a piece of Corroded Legendary gear. If it is successful, all Corrosion Base affixes will be re-rolled. If it fails, the gear's Corrosion affixes will vanish, and the gear will become bound.
5. Re-roll Undetermined Fate

Use TOWER Tokens - Undetermined Fate to re-roll Undetermined Fates. If it is successful, the type and quantity of Destiny slots of an Undetermined Fate will be re-rolled. If it fails, the Undetermined Fate will vanish.
6. Re-roll Fluorescent Memory Quantity

Use TOWER Tokens - Fluorescent to re-roll the quantity of a Fluorescent Memory. At least 1 Fluorescent Memory must be inserted, up to half of the exchanged quantity (rounded down) of the Fluorescent Memory. Fluorescent Memories with an exchange quantity of 1 cannot be inserted. This will change the quantity of a Fluorescent Memory randomly, doubling its quantity at most, and making it all vanish at the least.

## Ignite
An Ailment that deals Fire Damage Over Time.
Ignite deals Fire Damage Over Time and has a default duration of 4s.
When inflicted on an enemy, Ignite deals Fire Damage Over Time equal to the Base Ignite Damage every second to the target.

By default, the maximum number of Ignite stacks is 1 but can be upgraded later. When multiple Ignite effects act on a unit simultaneously, the N (Ignite Stack Limit) stacks of Ignite with the highest damage will take effect.
After reaching max stacks of Ignite, the duration of Ignite effects that deal more damage will not be affected by subsequently inflicted Ignite effects that deal less damage.

name: Ill Omen Additional Progression
text: ## Ill Omen Additional Progression
Ill Omen has 2 unique progression paths: Additional Base Effect and Reap Purification.
Additional Base Effect
Through character progression, each stack of Ill Omen can gain additional Base Effects, such as making monsters take more damage or inflicting Ailments on them.
Reap Purification
A special Ill Omen progression path.
Deals True Damage based on Max Life to monsters whenever they gain 1 stack of Ill Omen.

name: Ill Omen Base Mechanics
text: ## Ill Omen Base Mechanics

Ill Omen is an exclusive Damage Over Time mechanic. Dealing Damage Over Time to Cursed monsters will stack Ill Omen. When Ill Omen is triggered, all Ill Omen stacks are consumed to eliminate non-Elite enemies or deal lots of True Damage to Elite enemies.
The base Max Stacks of Ill Omen is 10 stacks. Inflicts 1 stack of Ill Omen whenever the cumulative Damage Over Time dealt to a monster reaches the trigger threshold.
Non-Elite enemies: Single-stack trigger threshold = 8% of the Max Life of non-Elite enemies.
Elite enemies: Single-stack trigger threshold = 5% of the Max Life of Elite enemies.
Ill Omen is triggered upon reaching max stacks, consuming all Ill Omen stacks to instantly eliminate non-Elite enemies and deal True Damage equal to 20% of Max Life to Elite enemies.
Supreme bosses will only trigger Ill Omen once.

name: Ill Omen Trigger Effect
text: ## Ill Omen Trigger Effect
Through character progression, Ill Omen can gain additional effects such as Spread, Restoration, Movement Speed, etc., when triggered.
Ill Omen Spread
Triggering Ill Omen inflicts Ill Omen stacks on nearby non-Elite enemies.
Trigger Buffs
Triggering Ill Omen grants Life Restoration, increased Movement Speed, Damage Over Time bonuses, and other additional buffs, helping DoT builds stay alive and mobile where they usually struggle.

## Injury Buffer
Injury Buffer is a defensive mechanic against Hit Damage.
Injury Buffer from different sources can stack proportionally, up to 80%%.
When receiving Hit Damage, part of the damage will not be deducted from Life or Energy Shield directly. Instead, it will be gradually deducted over the next 4s.
Injury Buffer does not change hit events or the damage of hits. It will only affect the deduction of Life or Energy Shield. Injury Buffer is not damage.

text: ## Item Viewing Mode
Trade House offers two item browsing modes - [Simplified Mode] and [Detailed Mode]. You can find the [Switch Mode] button at the bottom right corner of the item screen.
Simplified Mode
The [Simplified Mode] displays more items on one page with only their icons, names, quantities, and prices. You need to click on a specific item for more details.
Detailed Mode
The [Detailed Mode] displays more item info for you to make purchase decisions at the cost of showing fewer items.

name: Life
text: ## Life
Units are defeated when their Life is 0.
Max Life
Units are defeated when their Life is 0.
Players have 50 Max Life by default.
Max Life increases by 13 for every level gained.
Life Regeneration
Life Restoration Over Time.
Low Life
When a unit's current Life ≤ 35%% of Max Life, the Life is regarded as low.
Full Life
When a unit's current Life ≥ 95%% of Max Life, the Life is regarded as full.
Temporary Life
Additionally granted Life that is deducted first when taking damage. Temporary Life is included in Current Life and Max Life.
Base Max Life
The portion of Max Life that does not include Temporary Life.

Consumes 2% of Life to restore 8% of Max Life when you are hit. Interval: 0.2s.

## Lucky

Certain random results in combat are affected by Luck: When Lucky, the result is rolled multiple times and the more favorable one is kept. When Unlucky, the less favorable one is kept. The two effects can cancel each other out.
Lucky & Unlucky

Certain random results in combat (such as damage rolls, Critical Strikes, Blocking, Evading and more) are affected by Lucky and Unlucky. They take effect by changing the number of rolls for the result:
Lucky: The result is rolled twice, and the more favorable one is kept.
Very Lucky: The result is rolled three times, and the most favorable one is kept.
Unlucky: The result is rolled twice, and the less favorable one is kept.
When Lucky and Unlucky are both present, they cancel each other out. When Very Lucky and Unlucky are both present, they cancel into Lucky.

## Lunar Harp Tuning - Help
1. The Lunar Harp is a key item for activating Lunar Stone Statues and can be upgraded by leveling it up or equipping Lunar Strings.

2. Level up the Lunar Harp by defeating Lunari monsters at a corresponding difficulty to gain XP. The Lunar Harp automatically levels up when it reaches the required XP (max Lv. 5). Leveling up the Lunar Harp further increases the Drop Quantity Bonus granted by the Combo count and unlocks new Lunar String slots.

3. Lunar Strings are a special item that amplifies the abilities of the Lunar Harp (cannot be traded or replicated when dropped). Each unique Lunar String carries a unique special effect and 2 random affixes. Picked up Lunar Strings are placed in your Lunar String Inventory and must be equipped in a Lunar String slot to be activated.

4. When entering a low-level stage with a high-level Lunar Harp equipped, the Lunar Harp's level may be temporarily reduced (which causes parts that require a corresponding level to unlock to become ineffective).

name: Mana
text: ## Mana
20% of damage is taken from Mana instead of Life
+12% additional Max Mana
## Mana
20% of damage is taken from Mana instead of Life
+12% additional Max Mana
## Mana
Mana is used to cast skills. Skills cannot be cast when they cost more than the character's current Mana.
Max Mana
Players have 40 Max Mana by default.
Max Mana increases by 5 for every level gained.
Mana Regeneration
Restores Mana over time.
Players regenerate 7 Mana every second by default.
Players regenerate 1.75%% Mana every second by default.
Mana Instant Restoration
Instantly restores a certain amount of Mana.
Instantly restores a certain amount of Mana when the condition of the affix is satisfied. For example:
Restores 5 Mana on hit
Restores 1% Mana when using skills.
Prioritized Reduction of Mana
When taking damage, a certain percentage of the damage taken will be deducted from Mana instead. The player will take the remaining damage when they have insufficient Mana.
Low Mana
When a unit's current Mana ≤ 35%% of Max Mana, the Mana is regarded as low.
Full Mana
When a unit's current Mana ≥ 95%% of Max Mana, the Mana is regarded as full.
Temporary Mana
Additionally granted Mana that is deducted first when using Max Mana. Temporary Mana is included in Current Mana and Max Mana.
Base Max Mana
The portion of Max Mana that does not include Temporary Mana.

name: Map Material
text: ## Map Material

Map Materials are items used to add targeted affixes to Netherrealm Stages. Map Materials added before a stage starts will be consumed upon entry and converted into Stage Affixes, granting the stage richer drops, new gameplay, and an enhanced combat experience.

Map Materials are items used to add targeted affixes to Netherrealm Stages. Map Materials added before a stage starts will be consumed upon entry and converted into Stage Affixes, granting the stage richer drops, new gameplay, and an enhanced combat experience.
Map Materials are categorized into three types: Compasses, Season Compasses, and Probes. They differ in terms of functions and acquisition methods.
Compass

You can place a maximum of 4 Compass(es) in each Netherrealm stage. Starting from the unlocking of Compass slots at Timemark 7, the maximum number of Compasses that can be placed is gradually unlocked as the Timemark increases.

Compasses usually provide affixes that change the gameplay experience or enhance specific types of item drops, accompanied by a negative effect that increases the Life of all monsters in Netherrealm stages.
Compasses drop everywhere in Netherrealm.
Season Compass
You can place a maximum of 1 Season Compass(es) in each Netherrealm stage.
Season Compasses are exclusive to the current season-exclusive gameplay, providing gameplay variations and increased drops.
Season Compasses are usually dropped from the Season-exclusive Gameplay.
Probe
You can place a maximum of 1 Probe(s) in each Netherrealm stage. Probes can only be used in Profound Timemark 8 and Deep Space.
Probes provide affixes similar to Compasses but with stronger negative effects, making them items intended for late-game players.
Probes are usually dropped from Sandlord gameplay.

## Memory Revival
Adds several different powerful effects to Hero Memories, including Hero Trait Affixes tailored to each hero.
After the Memory Revival feature is unlocked as you progress through the main story, you can Revive Hero Memories at [Pristine Lunar String Cynthia] in the Town.
There are 3 types of Memory Revival: New Moon Revival, Half-Moon Revival, and Full Moon Revival, each of which unlocks different crafting effects for Memories of different tiers.
New Moon Revival includes: Young Moon
Half-Moon Revival includes: Wax and Wane and Young Moon
Full Moon Revival includes: Wax and Wane, Rising Moon, Young Moon, and Young Moon: Lunar Phase.
Using Memory Revival materials randomly grants the following effects to Hero Memories:
Wax and Wane: Increases Base Stat values
Rising Moon: Increases the tiers of Fixed Affixes
Young Moon: Adds an additional Revived Affix. Using a targeted Revival Material "Lunar Phase" has a chance to add a targeted Revived Affix (Lunar Phase)
Each module has its own success rate and does not affect each other. The effect will be granted upon success.

Revived Hero Memories can be revived again. Reviving again randomly re-rolls from the initial state, with the option to keep the result before or after revival. Different Memories have a maximum limit on revival attempts. Materials consumed per revival increase with the number of attempts and stop increasing upon reaching the limit. Choosing to keep the result before revival will still consume materials and revival attempts.
You can only install 1 Revived Hero Memory.
When performing Full Moon Revival, if a Revived Affix (Lunar Phase) was not obtained after using a targeted Revival material, the Revived Hero Memory will become bound.
## Memory Revival - Help
1. Using Memory Revival materials randomly grants the following effects to Hero Memories:
Wax and Wane: Increases Base Stat values
Rising Moon: Increases the tiers of Fixed Affixes
Young Moon: Adds an additional Revived Affix. Using the targeted revival material "Lunar Phase" has a chance to add a targeted Revived Affix (Lunar Phase)
2. Each effect above has its own success rate and does not interact with the others. You gain the effect on success.

3. Revived Hero Memories can be revived again. Reviving again randomly re-rolls from the initial state, with the option to keep the result before or after revival. Different Memories have a maximum limit on revival attempts, and cannot be revived further once the limit is reached.

4. Materials are consumed for each revival, and the consumption increases with the number of attempts until reaching the limit. Choosing to keep the result before revival will still consume materials and revival attempts.
5. Each character can install at most 1 revived Hero Memory.

name: Memory Upgrade
text: ## Memory Upgrade
Upgrade the Trait Level and Affix Stats of Hero Memories.
After the Memory Enhancing feature is unlocked as you progress through the main story, you can upgrade Hero Memories at [Skill Trader - Molina] in the Town.
Consume Memory Scraps to increase the Enhancement Level of Memories and increase the values of their Base Stats.

After upgrading a Memory to a certain level, you can also upgrade the Memory's Trait Level or add additional Random Affixes to the Memory, but you will need to consume Memory Threads of the corresponding quality.
Memory Threads can be obtained by breaking down Hero Memories of the same rarity.
The Memory Reconstruction feature can also be used to re-roll the Random Affixes of Memories.

## Mistville Exploration - Help
1. This is the Mistville exploration screen. Hunters must dispel the thick mist at the cost of their Sanity, unveiling the obscured Cells and seeking out the Clock Tower to welcome a new day.

2. Cells available for exploration will have a Sanity cost indicator on them, denoting the amount of Sanity Hunters need to spend to explore them. When Sanity runs out, the current gameplay round will end.

3.Each Cell houses a variety of elements, from Sanatoriums to Banks and Alchemy Workshops, each with its distinct purpose. To discover what a Cell has to offer, simply click on "View Cell Effect" or click and hold the Cell.

4. On odd-numbered days, Hunters will face the eerie Advent of Folklores within the Clock Tower. Overcoming the Folklores' challenges will reward Hunters with a Chest of Folklores that contains various types of rewards. Upon opening a Chest of Folklores, a bench will appear. Interact with the bench, and a new day will begin. Furthermore, completing the Advent of Folklores within the allotted time replenishes a portion of your Sanity.
5. On even-numbered days, interacting with the Clock Tower replenishes a portion of your Sanity and begins a new day directly.

6. As you traverse through various Cells, you can obtain a variety of Old Stuff and Food that can alter your exploration experience. Old Stuff will remain effective throughout your exploration, while Food items will be available in limited quantities.

name: Modularization
text: ## Modularization

Modularization Skills are Synthetic Troop summoning skills that can simulate certain monster abilities and have 1-3 random Modularization Affixes. Modularization Skills can be obtained as drops from defeating specific Netherrealm native Bosses after allocating large nodes in the Profound Talent Constellation.
Modularization Skills are Synthetic Troop summoning skills that can simulate certain monster abilities.
Modularization Skills have 1-3 random Modularization Affixes.
How to Obtain Modularization Skills

Modularization Skills can be obtained as drops from defeating specific Netherrealm native Bosses after allocating large nodes in the Profound Talent Constellation. The difficulty of Netherrealm Stages affects the number of Modularization Affixes on dropped Modularization Skills. Modularization Skills only drop at Timemark 8 or higher difficulty, and Modularization Skills with 3 Modularization Affixes only drop at Profound Timemark 8.

name: Monster
text: ## Monster - Monster Rarity - Help
Monsters are divided into Normal monsters, Magic monsters, Rare monsters, Legendary bosses, and Supreme bosses according to their rarity.
Among them, Rare monsters, Legendary bosses, and Supreme bosses are referred to as Elites.
Legendary and Supreme bosses are collectively referred to as bosses.

name: Monster Immunity
text: ## Monster Immunity
Supreme Bosses and Bosses in Supreme Showdown are immune to certain control effects and cannot be slowed.
All Supreme Bosses and Bosses in Supreme Showdown are immune to your Freeze and Knockback, and their Movement Speed, Attack Speed, and Cast Speed cannot be reduced below base values.

## Multistrike
Attack Skills have a chance to trigger Multistrike, automatically using the same Attack Skill a certain number of times consecutively.

Using an Attack Skill may has a chance to trigger Multistrike, automatically using this Attack Skill a certain number of times consecutively. Multistrike will not be triggered again during a Multistrike.

During Multistrike, each skill used will consume Mana or Life, and Multistrike will be interrupted when Mana or Life is insufficient. Multistrike will also be interrupted by moving or using other skills that are not accompanied by any actions or that will interrupt other skills.
Mobility Skills, Channeled Skills, and skills used by Sentries cannot trigger Multistrike.
By default, Multistrikes gain +20%% Attack Speed.
Multistrike Chance

Multistrike Chance is 0 by default. When the Multistrike Chance exceeds 100%, one additional attack is guaranteed to be performed after your initial attack, and each full 100% increment grants another additional attack. The excessive chance that is lower than 100% will be the chance of performing another additional attack after the additional attacks.
Multistrike Damage Increment

Each attack performed during Multistrike of the skill will receive additional damage bonus based on the Multistrike Damage Increment (the second attack receives the bonus once, the third attack receives the bonus twice, and so on).
Additional Multistrike Damage Increment
Additional Multistrike Damage Increment affects the "Multistrike Damage Increment" stat: its value will be multiplied by (100% + Additional Increment percentage).
Multistrike Count

The Multistrike Count starts from 1 (E.g. When the Multistrike Chance is 200%, the number of Multistrikes triggered by Attack Skills will be in a cycle of 1, 2, 3...). The Max Multistrike Count depends on the Multistrike Chance.

name: My Booth
text: ## My Booth
You can list items that you want to sell in Trade House via Trade House - [My Booth].
Booth Types
There are two types of booths: [Normal Booth Tabs] and [Premium Booth Tabs]. The only difference between them is the number of items allowed to be listed.
Premium Booth Tabs are available for purchase in [Shop] - [Account], and there's a cap on how many of them you can buy each season.

Normal Booth Tabs are free, but the number of slots you get to unlock depends on your level, You start off with 3 slot(s). As you reach Lv. 70, you unlock 6 slots, and by Lv. 90, you'll have 9 slots at your disposal.

## Nether Kings Divinity
Nether Kings Divinity

Added the Nether King's Divinity progression system for Divinity Slates. Nether King's Divinity is a special craftable Divinity that can be placed on the Divinity Slate panel. Each character can equip up to 1 at a time.

Nether King's Divinity has its own sockets and forms. By consuming Divine Remnants of various gods, players can inscribe Talent Nodes from different pantheons and types into Nether King's Divinity. Once all sockets are filled, Nether King's Divinity unlocks a special effect based on its type.
Basic Rules
Nether King's Divinity is divided into Incomplete Divinity and Complete Divinity:

Nether King's Broken Divinity has 2 sockets, making it suitable for quickly trying Nether King's Divinity crafting and special effects early on. Nether King's Broken Divinity comes in the following types: Nether King's Broken Divinity: Judgment, Nether King's Broken Divinity: Contamination, and Nether King's Broken Divinity: Banishment.

Nether King's Divinity has 3 sockets and supports higher-tier socket combinations, Brand Talent Node crafting, and locked affixes, making it the core pursuit for mid-to-late progression. Nether King's Divinity comes in the following types: Nether King's Divinity: Judgment, Nether King's Divinity: Contamination, and Nether King's Divinity: Banishment.
Nether King's Divinity slots are divided into four Quality tiers: blue, purple, orange, and red:
Blue Socket: Can inscribe a Small Nether King Talent Node.
Purple Socket: can inscribe Small Nether King Talent Nodes and Medium Nether King Talent Nodes.
Orange Socket: can inscribe Small Nether King Talent Nodes, Medium Nether King Talent Nodes, and Legendary Medium Nether King Talent Nodes.
Red Socket: can inscribe all Fixed Talent Nodes and Ultimate Nether King Talent Nodes.

Using Divine Remnant - Magic, Divine Remnant - Rare, or Divine Remnant - Legendary for each god randomly inscribes 1 affix from the corresponding Divinity Talent Node pool. Divine Remnants cover 6 pantheons: God of Might, Goddess of Hunting, Goddess of Knowledge, God of War, Goddess of Deception, and God of Machines.
Using Nether King's Divine Remnant randomly inscribes 1 Ultimate Nether King Talent Node from the Brand Talent Node pool.

Once all sockets on Nether King's Divinity are filled, crafting it again randomly replaces 1 affix in a replaceable socket. Complete Divinities can use Nether King's Soul Nail to lock 1 socket. Locked sockets will not be selected during subsequent replacement crafting.
Three types of Nether King's Divinity
Nether King's Divinity: Judgment
Divinity Slates on links between Divinities have 70% increased affix effect.
Nether King's Divinity: Contamination
Existing Brand Talents in Nether King's Divinity are projected at 20% strength to all Slates directly adjacent to the Divinity.
Nether King's Divinity: Banishment
"Banishment: Demolisher"

When casting a Demolisher skill, apply Paralysis to nearby enemies within 15 meters. Demolisher skills deal 20% additional damage to Paralyzed enemies. Bonuses to Paralysis effect also apply to this effect's bonus.
“Banishment: Steep Strike”

When using a Steep Strike skill, each 1% Steep Strike Chance above 100% grants +1% chance to trigger a Core Steep Strike skill, causing that triggered skill to deal +70% additional damage and gain +70% Skill Area.
"Banishment: Shadow Strike"
After using Attack Mobility Skill, Shadow Strike Skills damage +12% for 4 sec.
Casting Attack Mobility Skill triggers 2 core Shadow Strike Skills.
"Banishment: Spell Burst"
Skills cast by Spell Burst deal +28% additional On Hit Damage.
When Spell Burst charges reach the cap, trigger the Core Spell Skill on the nearest enemy within 25 meters and attempt to activate that Core Spell Skill's Spell Burst.
“Banishment: Ill Omen”
Nearby Elite within 15 meters have at least 4 stacks of Ill Omen.
When dealing Damage over Time, eliminate enemies with less than 20% Life.
Lose 3% of maximum Life and Max Energy Shield when you eliminate Elite.
“Banishment: Quagmire”
For every 1 Curse effect affecting an enemy, Terra skills deal +20% additional damage to it.
“Banishment: Projection”
When using Attack Horizontal Projectile skills, gain 1 stack of Nether King: Projection for 4 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
When Nether King: Projection reaches its cap, Horizontal Projectiles permanently Penetrate.
Nether King: Projection: +18% additional Attack Horizontal Projectile Damage; +6% additional damage taken from enemies in Proximity.
「Banishment: Provision」
Non-Restoration Elixir effects apply to Minions instead of yourself. +100% Elixir skill effect.
Minions affected by Elixir effects deal +15% additional damage.
“Banishment: Tangle”
Tangle attaches to Minions instead of enemies.
When creating Tangle, gain +1% additional Tangle Damage for every 40 maximum Life on the nearest Synthetic Troop Minion.
"Banishment: Indomitable"
When taking Fatal Damage, gain Temporary Life equal to 100% of maximum Life, then lose 100% of maximum Life over the next 4 seconds. This effect has a 20-second cooldown.
While this effect is Ready or Triggered, gain +30% additional Damage and Minion Damage.

## Netherrealm - Help
Clear Netherrealm stages to acquire XP, gear, and embers.
Certain stages may drop exclusive rare items.
## Netherrealm - Beacon - Help
Beacons are mainly acquired from the Netherrealm.
Better beacons have a chance to drop from the Bosses of Netherrealm.On top of that, the stage boss of Story Chapter 5 also drops beacons.
## Netherrealm - Map Affix - Help
The number of base affixes has an impact on a Netherrealm stage in terms of the Drop Quantity and Rarity.
You may reset affixes on a map to avoid dangerous harmful affixes or to pursue better potential rewards from Netherrealm stages.
Disciple monsters have 1 special effect, including: Restoration Over Time for Nearby monsters, Life restoration on hit, Erosion Terra generation upon defeat, and delayed Area Damage upon defeat.
## Netherrealm - Plane Watcher - Help
Each Plane Watcher yields Cinder along with bountiful and exclusive rewards.
## Netherrealm - Exclusive Drop - Help
Stages and bosses of each plane may drop exclusive items.
As the plane difficulty increases, more exclusive items will be added with higher drop rates.
Defeating the plane boss or the Traveler guarantees a piece of exclusive Legendary gear.
## Netherrealm - Plane Difficulty - Help
Defeating a plane boss enables you to increase the plane's difficulty.
This also makes your adventure more rewarding.
## Netherrealm - Unlock Plane - Help
Collect sufficient Cinders to unlock new Netherrealm planes.
You start over from different difficulties with these planes, and unlocking them will also yield additional Cinders.
## Netherrealm - Netherrealm Compass - Help
Netherrealm Compass Slots will unlock after you've collected 18 Cinders.
Use the Compasses before entering the map to bring both greater rewards and greater challenges.
## Netherrealm - Chaos Invasion - Help
After the Netherrealm Chaos Invasion begins, complete stages corresponding to the Confusion Cards to accumulate progress.
When the progress on Confusion Cards is complete, the current Chaos Invasion will end.
Adjustments made to Trait Cards only take effect when a new Chaos Invasion begins.
## Netherrealm - Trait Card - Help
After each round of Chaos Invasion, you can select one card from three Trait Cards and add it to the card library and manually set the Trait Cards to be used in the next round.
The decks of Trait Cards in the planes are mutually independent.
## Netherrealm - Confusion Card - Help
When Trait Cards with a certain tag in a deck of Trait Cards are more than the cards with other tags, the Confusion Cards with that specific tag have a higher chance to appear.
Maybe you can come up with unique strategies around some Confusion Cards...
## Netherrealm - Card Inheritance - Help
The effects of the cards with the keyword Inheritance last over time, affecting all the stages in the plane.
Some cards' effects will multiply rewards when they are combined via Inheritance.
## Netherrealm - Card Awakening - Help
Trait Cards have a really small chance to be awakened when drawn.
Awakened cards have way better values than the original cards.
The chance of awakening will be slightly enhanced along with the increase of the level of a card.
## Netherrealm - Traveler - Help
You can only challenge the Traveler after reaching the highest difficulty on all planes (collect 35 cinders).
As the current final boss, the Traveler is extraordinarily powerful, but players may challenge him as many times as they want.
After completing the first Traveler challenge, you will need to defeat four plane bosses to be able to challenge the Traveler again.
## Netherrealm - Help
About Beacons:
1. Beacons are required to start a Netherrealm stage. Each Netherrealm stage can only be started with a specified Beacon.
2. The best way to obtain Beacons is to defeat monsters in the Netherrealm.
3. Typically, the rank of the dropped Beacon matches the Timemark of its respective plane, but it will not be higher than the level of the stage where the Beacon is dropped.
About Plane Watcher:

1. You'll earn Starshards for completing each Netherrealm stage. Once you've collected enough Starshards, you can challenge the Plane Watcher of that Timemark. 2. Defeating the Plane Watcher unlocks a series of more challenging Netherrealm content, including new planes, new Timemarks, and endgame bosses.
About Netherrealm:
1. Netherrealm is divided into four phases, and you must defeat the Traveler of each phase to advance to the next phase. Both the difficulty and rewards increase with each phase.
Others:
1. Progress in the Netherrealm is shared across the same account and season. In other words, all characters on the same account share the same Netherrealm during a season.

name: Numbed
text: ## Numbed
An Elemental Ailment that has a chance to be inflicted when Lightning Damage hits its target.

When hitting a Numbed enemy, Lightning Damage inflicts 1 stack of Numbed for every 10% of the sum of Max Energy Shield and Life dealt by Lightning Damage. This threshold can be lowered or raised, but the minimum is 1%.
The default duration of Numbed is 2s, and the duration of each stack is calculated independently.
Max Numbed stacks: 10. Each stack of Numbed increases the Lightning Damage taken by an additional +5%.
Thunder Focus
Attack Lightning Damage is additionally increased and has a chance to Numb enemies. Upon reaching 100 Focus Pts, using a non-Mobility Attack Skill will trigger a Thunderstrike to attack the enemy.

Changes the base effect of Numbed to: +8% additional damage taken

name: Others
text: ## Others /0
## Others
Other damage-related mechanics: Elimination, Severe Injury, Overflown Damage, Fatal Damage.
Elimination
Directly defeats the target.
Cause Severe Injury

When the attacker deals damage to the same defender, if the total amount of damage exceeds 50%% x (Max Life + Max Energy Shield) of the defender within 0.5s, then the attacker causes Severe Injury once. After that, the recorded Severe Injury value will be reset to zero.
Take Severe Injury

When hit, if the total damage taken within 0.5s from any source exceeds 50%% x (Max Life + Max Energy Shield), then the defender will suffer Severe Injury once. After that, the recorded Severe Injury value will be reset to zero.
Overflown Damage
When killing a defender in 1 hit, the extra damage is regarded as overflown damage.
Fatal Damage
Single instance of damage that defeats a target.

name: Own Base Shock Damage:
text: ## Own Base Shock Damage
Own Base Shock Damage:
The character's own Base Shock Damage calculates the sum of Base Shock Damage added. For example: Adds 1 Base Shock Damage.
However, it doesn't calculate the Base Shock Damage obtained. For example: Gains 3% of Lightning Damage as Base Shock Damage on hit.

## Pactspirit
Pactspirits will change Pact Point effects. One Pactspirit can follow you around and automatically loot some items.
Pactspirit installation will change the effects of Pact Nodes in the current area: You can switch to the original Pact Nodes anytime.
Pactspirits of different rarity can cause different scopes of change. Legendary Pactspirits will change all the Pact Nodes in the area.
Pactspirits that are not installed can follow you around in the scene but can only automatically loot some drops.
## Pactspirit - Help
About Pactspirits:
1. Pactspirits come in two main types: Battle Pactspirits and Drop Pactspirits, and 3 of each type can be installed.
2. Installed Battle Pactspirits have their own exclusive Pact Pages.
3. Installed Rare Pactspirits can unlock Pact Points in advance.
4. No allocations are required for Drop Pactspirits as all their Talent Node effects are activated upon installation.
5. Any Pactspirit, installed or not, can be selected to follow you and automatically pick up some loot.
About Destinies:
1. Destinies can be installed in Talent Nodes where you've already allocated points in the Pact Page to replace the original effects of the Talent Nodes.
2. Installing a Destiny doesn't cost anything. When removing a Destiny, it is possible to select 2 different types of materials, each yielding a different outcome.

3. Destinies are divided into Micro and Medium Destinies, and each type of Destiny has a separate installation quantity limit, which is gradually unlocked by completing specific quests. Refer to [Installation Limit] on the right side of the Pact Page for details.

4. Undetermined Fates are installed in Undetermined Fate Slots, granting a number of additional Destiny Slots that do not count toward the installation limit of Destinies. Undetermined Fates do not count toward the total number of installed Destinies.

name: Pactspirit Rally
text: ## Pactspirit Rally - Help
1. During the event, purchasing this feature grants account-wide access to Rally Pactspirits for the current season.

2. You can select 3 different sets of Drop Pactspirits from the Pactspirit pool for support. Each set contains 1 T1 Legendary, 1 T4 Rare, and 1 T6 Magic Pactspirit corresponding to the season-exclusive gameplay.

3. Once selected, the set of Rally Pactspirits will be added to your Pactspirit List as independent limited-time Pactspirits with exclusive tags. The tiers of Rally Pactspirits and owned Pactspirits do not affect each other.

4. After a set is first selected and after every subsequent change, you must wait 24 hours before changing it again. The cooldown for each set is calculated independently. Upon changing, the original Rally Pactspirits will be removed, and any active pacts will be automatically canceled.

5. Rally Pactspirits can follow you or form a pact on the Shortcut Tab or Regular Tab of the Pact. Once they form a pact, their effects apply according to their tier and skill descriptions. Rally Pactspirits and owned Pactspirits of the same name can be chosen freely, but cannot form a pact simultaneously.
6. Rally Pactspirits cannot be upgraded or exchanged into Insight Essences.
7. After the season ends, Rally Pactspirits will automatically expire and be removed.

## Path of Progression - Help
Intro:
1. The Path of Progression contains a set of goals that span the entire game cycle, helping Hunters to have a better understanding of each section of the game.
2. These goals are tied to seasons and can be accomplished by any character within that season.

3. Path of Progression rewards are Account Level rewards that are divided into first rewards and regular rewards. Any character under the current account can receive the first reward when completing goals in Path of Progression for the first time. Upon completing Path of Progression goals again in subsequent seasons, regular rewards can be claimed instead. All rewards claimed in subsequent seasons after claiming the first reward are regular rewards.
4. The rewards and goals of Path of Progression will be reset every season. Due to seasonal content updates, the goals and rewards in future seasons may be adjusted.

name: Plane Watcher
text: ## Plane Watcher
Each plane has a unique Legendary boss known as the Plane Watcher.
Each plane has a unique Legendary boss known as the Plane Watcher.
Plane Watchers are powerful and dangerous, but they offer unique exclusive drops.
Clearing a Netherrealm stage grants Starshards. Collect enough Starshards to challenge the Plane Watcher.
Defeating the Plane Watcher can increase Timemark.
Plane Watchers in Timemark 7, 8, and Profound Timemark 8 also drop materials required to unlock Traveler challenges.
Plane Watcher - Profound Timemark 8
Plane Watcher - Profound Timemark 8 has 6 difficulty level(s).
Defeat the Plane Watcher of the current difficulty to unlock the next. Plane Watchers at higher difficulty levels have increased Drop Quantity.
Plane Watchers at the highest difficulty will drop Conquest Insignias, which can be exchanged for Outfit rewards.

name: Planes
text: ## Planes
Netherrealm has 5 planes: Glacial Abyss, Blistering Lava Sea, Steel Forge, Thunder Wastes, and Voidlands.
Netherrealm has 5 planes: Glacial Abyss, Blistering Lava Sea, Steel Forge, Thunder Wastes, and Voidlands.
The five planes correspond to the five damage types: Cold, Fire, Physical, Lightning, and Erosion.
Different damage types will be reflected in the monsters and environment in planes.
Unlocking Planes
Only the Glacial Abyss plane is unlocked when you first enter the Netherrealm. Other planes must be unlocked one by one by increasing Timemark.

name: Proof of the Brave
text: ## Proof of the Brave /5

Proof of the Brave I: Proof of Reaching Level 1 of High Tower · When people hold this seal in their hands, the light on them will be extinguished, and the door to the Infinity Tower will open... Only the brave who are ready to dive into the darkness will choose this path.

Proof of the Brave II: Proof of Reaching Level 11 of High Tower · The miniature of the world flows in the palm of the brave. It is a corner of the great existence projected on this world. After searching through countless worlds, the brave has finally earned the right to meet her.

Proof of the Brave III: Proof of Reaching Level 21 of High Tower · This is her fragment. This is her dress. It is a part of her body... The brave is getting closer and closer to the reality of the world, but the light on the hero's body has become dimmer.

Proof of the Brave IV: Proof of Reaching Level 31 of High Tower · Darkness has been a part of you forever. Even in your sleep, you hear the call of the greatness. She is waiting for you. She knows you will be back again.

Proof of the Brave V: Proof of Reaching Level 41 of High Tower · The seal is covered in the tears of the greatness. Now the brave can finally reach her untouchable soul... Behind the endless veil of the void, it is not the gods that stand forever. In the strange eternity, even time can be shattered.

name: Regain
text: ## Regain
This is an instant restoration mechanic. It immediately restores a portion of the player's Missing Life or Energy Shield on hit.
Regain is divided into Life Regain and Shield Regain. The upper limit of both Life Regain and Shield Regain is 30%%.
Regain has a Regain Interval. The base interval is 0.5s. Life Regain and Shield Regain have separate Regain Intervals.

name: Regular Pactspirit Setting
text: ## Regular Pactspirit Setting - Help
After assigning Regular Drop Pactspirits for a specific gameplay, all drops from that gameplay will benefit from the Regular Pactspirit combination and are affected solely by that combination.

This feature is unlocked via the Golden Season Pass. Certain gameplay modes are temporarily free during the season. If this feature is locked, gameplay drops will apply the currently equipped Drop Pactspirit Plan.
Refer to each gameplay's effective rules for detailed drop mechanics.

text: ## Resistance

+20% chance to avoid Elemental Ailment
## Resistance
+1% chance to avoid Elemental Ailments for every 1% effective Erosion Resistance
## Resistance
Resistance is an effective survival mechanic that directly reduces the corresponding type of damage taken by a certain percentage.

There are 4 types of Resistance: Fire Resistance, Lightning Resistance, Cold Resistance, and Erosion Resistance. Fire Resistance, Lightning Resistance, and Cold Resistance are collectively referred to as Elemental Resistance.
When monsters deal a large amount of damage, it is mainly Elemental Damage, so increasing your Elemental Resistance will effectively reduce a large amount of Elemental Damage you'll take from them.
Effective Resistance.
Your initial Elemental Resistance and Erosion Resistance are 0.
The base Max Resistance is 60%% for all Resistances. This can be changed by increasing the Max Resistance %%. Max Resistance is capped at 90%%.
The final effective Resistance is the smaller value between the player's current Resistance and the Max Resistance

name: Resistance Penetration
text: ## Resistance Penetration
When calculating the damage, the defender's Resistance is calculated at a lower value.
As a stat that counteracts Resistance, Resistance Penetration acts on the defender's effective Resistance in the damage calculation process.

Upon inflicting damage, if the attacker has Resistance Penetration of a certain type, the defender's Resistance will be reduced accordingly by the value of the Resistance Penetration when calculating the damage.
Resistance Penetration does not change the actual value of the defender's Resistance.
Resistance Penetration takes effect on all forms of damage (Hit, DoT, Secondary, Reflect).

## Restoration
Restoration Skills provide various types of Life or Mana restoration effects.
Restoration Skills provide various types of Life or Mana restoration effects that typically restore a certain amount of Life or Mana within a certain period of time.
Restoration Skills typically have at least 2 Charge(s) and need to gain Charging Progress through actions such as defeating enemies. Restoration Skills are usually not accompanied by any actions.

When Life or Mana is fully restored, currently active Life or Mana Restoration effects will be removed before they expire, but the Restoration period is deemed to continue as long as one type of Restoration effect is still active.
Restoration Duration
Restoration effects from Restoration skills are affected by Restoration Duration bonuses, but are not affected by the skill effect duration attribute.

Changes to the Restoration Duration will not affect the total amount restored by each casting of the Restoration Skill. When the Restoration Duration is extended, the amount restored per second by the Restoration Skill will be reduced.
Restoration Effect
The total restoration amount of a Restoration Skill is affected by Restoration Effect bonuses.
Restoration value = Base value x (1 + all non-additional bonus percentages) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 1) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 2)...

name: Revival Token
text: ## Revival Token
A resource used to revive your character.
## Path of Achievements /19

Story | Raise Total Elemental Resistance to 50% | Total Elemental Resistance reaches 50% / Elemental Resistances will effectively reduce the corresponding Spell Damage. Balance out your various Resistances while raise them much as possible. / Reward: Revival Token x1

Story | Raise Life and Energy Shield to 850 | Sum of life and Energy Shield reaches 850 / Life and Energy Shield are essential for your survival. Prioritize those two first when you aim to increase your defensive stats. / Reward: Revival Token x1
Story | Erosion Resistance increases to 50% | Reach 50% Erosion Resistance / Reward: Revival Token x1
Story | Raise Main Skill DPS to 50000 | Raise Main Skill DPS to 50000 / DPS shows how powerful a skill is. Try different combinations to optimize your DPS / Reward: Revival Token x1
Progression | Activate Medium Talent Node | Activate 1 Medium Talent Node / You must first unlock the prerequisites before activating the more powerful superior Talent Node / Reward: Revival Token x1

Progression | Activate 1 Major Talent Node | Activate 1 Major Talent Node / Major Talent Nodes are the two unique talents on a Talent Panel. Activate a certain number of Talent Nodes on a panel to unlock the powerful Major Talent Nodes. / Reward: Revival Token x1

Progression | Complete a Skill 2-Link | Link 1 Support Skill to 2 Active Skills / Support Skills provide various effects for the Active Skill to which they are linked. Unlock as many Support Skill Slots and find your unique combination / Reward: Revival Token x1

Progression | Activate 1 Aura Skill | Activate the first Aura Skill / Auras are Passive Skills that give powerful beneficial effects. Activating an aura may Seal a portion of your Life or Mana. / Reward: Revival Token x1

Progression | Complete a Skill 4-Link | Link 3 Support Skills to 1 Active Skill / Support Skills provide various effects for the Active Skill to which they are linked. Unlock as many Support Skill Slots and find your unique combination / Reward: Revival Token x1

Progression | Equip a Defensive Skill | Equip a skill with the tag / Defensive Skills can significantly increase a character's survivability for a short time. Use it wisely while facing powerful enemies. / Reward: Revival Token x1

Progression | Complete a Skill 6-Link | Link 5 Support Skills to 1 Active Skill / Support Skills provide various effects for the Active Skill to which they are linked. Unlock as many Support Skill Slots and find your unique combination / Reward: Revival Token x1

Gameplay | Wear Magic gear | Equip 2 pieces of Magic or better gear / There are five gear qualities: Normal, Magic, Rare, Super Rare, and Legendary. The max number of affixes an item may have will increase with its quality. Legendary gear may have exclusive special affixes. / Reward: Revival Token x1

Gameplay | Wear Rare gear | Equip 6 pieces of Rare or better gear / There are five gear qualities: Normal, Magic, Rare, Super Rare, and Legendary. The max number of affixes an item may have will increase with its quality. Legendary gear may have exclusive special affixes. / Reward: Revival Token x1
Gameplay | Use Ground Quartz | Use 10 Ground Quartz / Reward: Revival Token x1
Gameplay | Use Ground Quartz | Use 10 Ground Quartz / Reward: Revival Token x1
Gameplay | Wear Legendary gear (exclusive) | Equip 1 Legendary gear (exclusive drops) / Netherrealm bosses may drop special Legendary gear that has unique effects. / Reward: Revival Token x1

Gameplay | Upgrade Gear Affix | Equipped gear has a total of 12 T1 or above affixes / Each affix has a randomly assigned rank based on the gear item level. The higher the item level, the more likely high-rank affixes are rolled on the item. / Reward: Revival Token x1
Netherrealm | Challenge Plane Watcher | Defeat Plane Watcher 15 times / Reward: Revival Token x1
Netherrealm | Challenge Netherrealm | Complete 10 Netherrealm Maps with 10 affixes / Reward: Revival Token x1

name: Ring of Blades
text: SS14Season
Ring of Blades
Spell Channeled Physical Area Persistent Projectile Horizontal
Main Stat:
Intelligence
Mana Cost
Cast Speed
Cooldown
Effectiveness of added damage
Simple
When channeling this skill, generates ring blades around you, dealing 379-631 Spell Physical Damage to enemies within range.
The ring blades will remain for 5s after the channeling is over.
Movement is not restricted when this skill is being channeled.
Details
Ring of Blades:
Deals 379-631 Spell Physical Damage
For the same enemy, Projectiles can deal damage once every 0.25s at the fastest
Max channeled stacks: 5
Generates 1 Projectile for each channeling, up to 5 Projectile(s)
After channeling, Projectiles will remain for 5s
Movement is not restricted when the skill is being channeled
This skill 21.5 % additional damage for every +1 additional Max Channeled Stack(s)
-30% Movement Speed while channeling this skill
The orbiting radius of Projectiles is also affected by the skill's Skill Area bonuses.
This skill is not affected by Projectile Size

name: Ruins of Aeterna
text: ## Ruins of Aeterna
You must pay one Aeterna Reverberation every time you enter the Ruins of Aeterna.
You must pay one Aeterna Reverberation every time you enter the Ruins of Aeterna.
Aeterna Reverberation - Fleeting can unlock Lv. 83 Ruins of Aeterna, while Aeterna Reverberation - Eternal can unlock Lv. 85 Ruins of Aeterna.
After selecting a certain number of grids and paying Aeterna Reverberations, the Ruins of Aeterna will be generated in a randomized shape with the selected number of grids.
Mark of the Ruins
After entering Ruins of Aeterna, you need to complete as many Candelabrum Challenges as possible to activate the grid where the Candelabrum is located.

Regardless of the result, a Mark of the Ruins with the same shape as the Ruins of Aeterna will be generated after you exit the ruins. Its completeness will correspond to the number of activated grids within the Ruins of Aeterna.
Marks of the Ruins will be fitted into the Aeterna Map in Aeterna construction later to construct the City of Aeterna.

You can reset Marks of the Ruins that have a low degree of completion. After the reset, you can challenge the previous Ruins of Aeterna again for Marks of the Ruins that have a higher degree of completion.
Options
Only the 6-grid option is available by default when you select the number of grids for the Ruins of Aeterna. The 4-grid option needs to be unlocked through Psalms of Aeterna.
The 4-grid option sacrifices coverage but doubles the covered room's rewards.

The 4-grid option and the 6-grid option both have their advantages and disadvantages. Click the small button at the right upper corner of the screen to check the current Aeterna Map before you make your choice.

Effectiveness of added damage
Simple
When channeling the skill, charges forward, passing through the enemies while moving, dealing 57% Weapon Attack Damage continuously, and knocking them back.

If the channeling of this skill stops at max channeled stacks, a Savage Strike will be launched, dealing 570% Weapon Attack Damage to the enemies in front and knocking them back. Demolisher Charge additionally increases this attack's damage.
Channeled stacks will increase the Skill Area of the skill when the character is charging using this skill.

Max channeled stacks: 5.
+12% Skill Area per channeled stack

name: Seal
text: ## Seal
When activating a Passive or Triggered Skill, a portion of your Mana will become unusable. This is called Sealed Mana. These skills cannot be activated when you have insufficient Mana remaining.

When activating a Passive or Triggered Skill, a portion of your Mana will become unusable. This is called Sealed Mana. These skills cannot be activated when you have insufficient Mana remaining. Sealed Mana cannot be used or sealed again.
Sealed Life
In certain circumstances, a portion of the Mana sealed when activating skills can be converted to Sealed Life.
If the conversion percentage is greater than or equal to 100%, this skill will only seal an amount of Life equal to the corresponding percentage of Mana.
If the skill doesn't seal Mana, this effect will not apply to it.

name: Select Ruins of Aeterna
text: ## Select Ruins of Aeterna - Help
1. After selecting a certain number of grids, the Ruins of Aeterna will be generated with a randomized shape that corresponds to the selected grid count.
2. Hunters must enter the Ruins of Aeterna and complete as many Candelabrum challenges as possible within a specified time frame in order to activate the grid where the Candelabrum is located.

3. Regardless of the result, a Mark of the Ruins with the same shape as the Ruins of Aeterna will be generated after Hunters exit the ruins. This mark will later be integrated into the Aeterna Map during the subsequent Aeterna construction. Its completeness will correspond to the number of activated grids within the Ruins of Aeterna.
4. The option on the left requires clearing the Psalms of Aeterna to unlock.

5. Both options have their own pros and cons depending on the situation. You can click on the small button at the top right corner of the screen to view the round's Aeterna Map and analyze the pros and cons before making your choice.

text: ## Tide Whisper /2

Sing with the Tide: In Bard form, you can encase skills in bubbles while moving. When a bubble bursts, the skill within is cast at that location, creating a Tide. In Loud Song form, you can deal significantly increased damage when standing in the Tide.

Dance of the Deep: Makes Terra Skills follow you as you move. Dance with them to gain multiple Terra Skill-related bonuses and auto-use your Main Terra Skill. Different Dance Steps also grant Movement Speed, Survival, and Damage buffs.

## Sentry
Sentry Skills can be used to deploy different types of Sentries. Sentries are unable to move but will automatically cast skills at enemies within their Tracking Area.

Sentry Skills can be used to deploy different types of Sentries. Sentries are unable to move but will automatically cast skills at enemies within a certain area. Each type of Sentry has a different Tracking Area.
When a Sentry hits, deals damage to, or defeats an enemy, it is considered that the player has hit, dealt damage to, or defeated this enemy.
The max number of Sentries in a map is 4.
Sentry Stats
Sentries' stats are inherited from the player, so their damage stat calculation should be the same as the player's. However, Sentries cannot activate Spell Burst or Multistrike.
Cast Frequency
The speed at which Sentries use skills is controlled by Cast Frequency and not Attack or Cast Speed. It is calculated in the same way as Attack and Cast Speed.

## Shadow Strike
When being cast, a Shadow Strike Skill can summon multiple Shadows to attack. Each Shadow attacks an enemy within the Tracking Area 1 time. Shadows use the same Attack Skills as the player.

Casting a Shadow Strike Skill can summon multiple Shadows to attack. Each Shadow attacks an enemy within the Tracking Area 1 time. Shadows use the same Attack Skills as the player. The default number of Shadows is 0.
Damage of Shadows
Shadows deal the same amount of damage as the player, but if multiple Shadows hit the same enemy at the same time, the damage from each Shadow beyond the first one will additionally -70%%.
Tracking Area of Shadows

The Tracking Area of Shadows is a circle with a radius of 9.5m around the player. This area is not affected by general area stats, and only enjoys exclusive Shadow Tracking Area stat bonuses. Shadows prioritize attacking enemies that have not been hit by the player or other Shadows.

name: Shock
text: ## Shock
The Shock status is an Ailment that could be triggered when Lightning Damage hits its target. It's affected by Shock Chance.
Shock Damage is settled one additional time every time enemies in the Shock status are hit.
Shock Damage is Secondary Lightning Damage. It is not affected by bonuses and ignores Resistance.
Each Shock status can be settled up to 12 time(s).
Shock cannot be inflicted when Base Shock Damage is 0.
## Shock
An Ailment that deals Secondary Lightning Damage.
When hitting an enemy with Shock, Secondary Lightning Damage is dealt based on the Base Shock Damage of this buff.
When hitting an enemy with Shock, Hit Damage is guaranteed to trigger Shock Damage.
Each Shock effect can only be triggered up to 12 time(s).
The base duration of Shock is 4s.
When hitting an enemy with Shock, Secondary Lightning Damage is dealt based on the recorded Base Shock Damage, and this damage bonus is obtained when it is triggered.
The maximum valid stack of Shock is 1. This can't be changed by any affixes. When multiple Shock effects exist concurrently, the stack with the highest Base Damage takes effect.
The player and their Minions gain initial Base Shock Damage equal to 3%% of the Lightning Damage hit.
Shock Damage is not affected by any bonuses and ignores Resistance.

## Skill - Support Skill - Help
Support Skills can enhance your Active Skills.
You can link up to 5 Support Skills to an Active Skill.
Choose Support Skills based on the tags of your Active Skill to significantly boost your combat prowess.
## Skill - Distribute Energy - Help
Spend energy to increase the number of links for a skill. You get energy by
leveling up and from gear that have energy stats.
## Skill - Passive - Help
Skills with the Passive tag need to be equipped at special Passive Skill slots.
Passive Skills have various powerful effects. Choose Passive Skills that suit you best.
## Skill - Sealed Mana|Life - Help

When certain skills are equipped (mostly Aura Skills and Triggered Skills), Mana will not be deducted when players use these skills. Instead, a portion of their Mana will enter an unusable state as the cost of using these skills. This is referred to as Sealed Mana. Similarly, Sealed Life is the process of sealing Life.
The sealing process does not change the Max Mana or Max Life.
A fixed amount of proportion of Mana and Life can be sealed. The amount of Mana or Life sealed is also affected by other skills and affixes.
Relevant Stats
Skill Sealed Mana
