## Skill - Aura - Help
Auras are Passive Skills.
Activating an Aura will Seal a portion of your Life or Mana.
Auras have their own special Support Skills, and multiple Auras can be linked together to receive the bonuses from the same Support Skill.
## Skill - Curse - Help
A variety of Curses will inflict different debuffs on monsters.
By default, a player may only apply one Curse to a monster at a time. Special gear or talents may allow you to exceed such a restriction.
## Skill - Empower - Help
Empower is an Active Skill tag. Skills with this tag provide temporary yet powerful stat buffs.
## Skill - Triggered - Help
Triggered Skills are a type of Passive Skill.
Meet specific conditions to activate skills that are linked to a Triggered Skill.
## Skill - Cast Skill - Help
Using or triggering a skill is called casting a skill in the game.
## Skill - Help
About Skill Slots:
1. Skill slots require energy to unlock, including active and passive unlocking.
2. The first slot of each skill tab passively unlocks when energy reaches the cap.
3. Players need to allocate energy to unlock other skill slots.
4. Energy can be gained by leveling up characters and equipping gear (excluding trinkets).
About Skills:
1. Skills are divided into Active Skills, Support Skills, Passive Skills and Triggered Skills.
2. Active and Passive Skills can be linked to Support Skills.
3. Triggered Skills can be linked to Active and Support Skills.
4. Available Support Skills that can be linked are identified by their skill tags.
5. Only one skill will be active when identical skills are equipped.
6. The availability of Active Skills depends on the weapons equipped by characters.

name: Skill Info
text: ## Skill Info
There are various types of skills. You can select the skills you want based on tags.
Skills can be divided into Active Skills, Support Skills, and Passive Skills.
Active Skills and Passive Skills can be linked to Support Skills.
Triggered Skills can be linked to Active Skills and Support Skills.
You can check the skill tags to find Support Skills that a skill can be linked to.
Only one skill will be active when identical skills are installed.
Whether an Active Skill can be used is determined by the weapons currently installed on the character.

name: Skill Level
text: ## Skill Level
The Base Damage and affix effects of skills increase with the skill level. Defeat enemies to gain Skill XP, which can be used to upgrade skills to Lv.20.
The Base Damage and affix effects of skills increase with the skill level. Defeat enemies to gain Skill XP, which can be used to upgrade skills to Lv.20.
Some special effects, such as affixes or drop skills also increase the skill level. This makes it possible for the actual level of skills to exceed Lv.20.

After the skill exceeds Lv. 20, its Base Damage and the Base Damage of its Minions will no longer change. However, for every level beyond this level, this skill and its Minions will gain additional damage. At Lv. 21 - 30, each level +10%% additional damage (multiplies) At Lv. 31 or higher, each level +8%% additional damage (multiplies).
For example: If the skill's current level is Lv.21, this skill deals an additional +10%% damage when it is higher than Lv.1.
The Base Damage of the following skills will not increase with their skill level:
Burst of Anger

name: Skill Slot Info
text: ## Skill Slot Info
The skill slots determine the number of skills that can be installed.
Skill slots need to be unlocked with Energy automatically or manually.
When Energy reaches the upper limit, the first skill slot on each page will be automatically unlocked.
Other skill slots need to be manually unlocked by allocating Energy.
Energy can be obtained through character upgrade and gear installation (except Trinkets).

name: Skill Slots
text: ## Skill Slots
Skill Slots are divided into Active Skill Slots, Passive Skill Slots, and Support Skill Slots. Generally, skills can only be equipped in their corresponding slots.
Skill Slots are divided into Active Skill Slots, Passive Skill Slots, and Support Skill Slots. Generally, skills can only be equipped in their corresponding slots.
Active Skill Slots
Active Skill slots include the first 5 skill slots on the Skill panel. Active Skill slots can also be sorted from top to bottom.
The Active Skill equipped in the first skill slot is known as the Main Skill.
Passive Skill Slots
Passive Skill Slots include the last 4 skill slots on the Skill panel. The Passive Skill Slots and Active Skill Slots are separated by a gap.
Support Skill Slots
The 5 skill slots around each Active or Passive Skill Slot are called Support Skill Slots.

name: Skill Speed
text: ## Skill Speed

The casting speed of skills that have actions is affected by Skill Speed bonuses. Skill Speed is further divided into Attack Speed and Cast Speed, which grant bonuses to Attack Skills and Spell Skills respectively.

The casting speed of skills that have actions is affected by Skill Speed bonuses. Skill Speed is further divided into Attack Speed and Cast Speed, which grant bonuses to Attack Skills and Spell Skills respectively.
Skill Speed represents how many skills can be used every second.
Attack Speed = Base Attack Speed x (1 + all non-additional bonus percentages) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 1) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 2)... The same applies to Cast Speed.

name: Skill Type
text: ## Skill Type
Skills are divided into Active Skills, Passive Skills, and Support Skills. Passive Skills and Support Skills can be further differentiated as being Normal or Precise.
Skills are divided into Active Skills, Passive Skills, and Support Skills. Passive Skills and Support Skills can be further differentiated as being Normal or Precise.
Active Skills
In general, Active Skills must be actively used by the player. They can be equipped to Active Skill Slots.
It is possible to equip multiple Active Skills that have the same name.
Passive Skills
Passive Skills are skills that only take effect when they are activated by the player. They can be equipped to Passive Skill Slots.
Only 1 Passive Skill of the same name can be equipped.
Support Skills
Support Skills are skills that can enhance and link to Active Skills or Passive Skills. They can be equipped to Support Skill Slots or Passive Skill Slots.
Support Skills have a Mana Multiplier stat, and the Mana Cost of linked Active Skills and Sealed Mana of linked Passive Skills will be multiplied by this multiplier.
For example: If the Mana Multiplier of a Support Skill is 110% and the Mana Cost of an Active Skill is 5, the final Mana Cost of the Active Skill is 5.5.
In each set of skill slots, only 1 Support Skill of the same name can be equipped.
Normal and Precise Skills
Passive Skills and Support Skills are further differentiated as being Normal or Precise. Precise skills are stronger than Normal skills.

name: Skill cost
text: ## Skill cost
Using Active Skills requires Mana. These skills cannot be used when there is insufficient Mana.
Using Active Skills requires Mana. These skills cannot be used when there is insufficient Mana.
Life Cost
In certain circumstances, a portion of the Mana Cost when using skills can be replaced with a Life Cost.
If the conversion percentage is greater than or equal to 100%, this skill will only consume Life equal to the corresponding percentage of Mana. The consumed Life is not regarded as damage taken.
If the skill doesn't cost Mana, this effect will not apply to it.

## Spell Burst
Automatically casts a Spell Skill a certain number of times.
Spell Burst

When Spell Burst is fully charged, casting a Spell Skill will activate Spell Burst, which will consume all stacks of Spell Burst charged and automatically cast the Spell Skill the same number of times as the number of stacks consumed.
Skills that are cast by Spell Burst, skills with a cooldown, Summon Skills, Sentry Skills, Channel Skills, and Triggered Skills cannot activate Spell Burst.
The Spell Skill that activates the Spell Burst is considered a skill cast by Spell Burst.
Spell Burst Charge cannot go beyond Spell Burst's upper limit. Spell Burst can only be cast when Max Spell Burst is no lower than 1.
Spell Burst Charge Speed
Spell Burst will be fully charged within 2s. Spell Burst Charge Speed will increase the restoration speed of Spell Burst Charge.
Full Spell Burst Charge Restoration Time = 2 / (100 + Spell Burst Charge Speed)% x (100 + additional Spell Burst Charge Speed 1)% x (100 + additional Spell Burst Charge Speed 2)%...
## Spell Burst
Spell Burst
Torchlight Infinite season 3 new spell mechanic: Spell Burst.

Added an upgrade system for spell skills. Consume spell burst when using or triggering channeled spell skills. According to the number of spell burst stacks consumed, automatically cast multiple spell skills in a burst in a short period of time.

When Spell Burst is fully charged, casting a Spell Skill will activate Spell Burst. When Spell Burst is cast, it will consume all stacks charged and cast the Spell Skill a number of times equal to the number of stacks consumed.
Skills that have a cooldown, Summon, Sentry, and Channeled Skills cannot activate Spell Burst.
The Spell Skill that activates the Spell Burst is considered a skill cast by Spell Burst.
Spell Burst Charge cannot go beyond Spell Burst's upper limit.
At least 1 Max Spell Burst is required before Spell Burst can be cast.
Spell Burst Charge will be fully charged in 2s.
Spell Burst Charge Speed will increase the restoration speed of Spell Burst Charge.
Spell Burst Guides

We have designed spell burst, a new developed system for spells with spell burst. Hunters can consume spellburst Stacks when using or triggering Channel spell skills based on the number of spellburst stacks consumed. They can automatically cast multiple spell skills in a burst within a short period of time allowing for easy semi-automatic spell casting.

Spell Burst is a powerful development system for spells. It enables Hunters to have a relaxed and smooth map clearing experience. It also allows them to move around neatly avoid enemy damage. However spellpers can only be consumed when it's at maximum Stacks. So, don't forget to upgrade the charge speed of Spell Burst when upgrading cast speed. We believe the additional of spell burst will bring spells to prominence.

## Spirit Magus
Spirit Magi are a type of Minion. Skills that summon Spirit Magi are typically Passive Skills.
Spirit Magi are a type of Minion. Skills that summon Spirit Magi are typically Passive Skills.
The max number of Spirit Magus Minions in a map is 2.
Each Spirit Magus has different skills, including Base Skills, Enhanced Skills, Empower Skills, and Ultimate. A Spirit Magus' stats are affected by Growth-related effects and bonuses.
Base Skill
Spirit Magi's most frequently used initial skill, which is relatively weak.
Enhanced Skills

Chance to change the skill into a stronger Enhanced Skill when Spirit Magi use a Base Skill. The chance can be increased, and at 100%, Spirit Magi will no longer use Base Skills and always use Enhanced Skills.
Empower Skill
Spirit Magi are able to use this type of skill from the very beginning. It provides Spirit Magi with a positive effect that increases damage for a period of time and has a cooldown.
Ultimate
In Full Bloom, Spirit Magi use their Ultimate with extremely high strength and a cooldown.
Only The Forsaken Iris - Growing Breeze can make Spirit Magi enter the Full Bloom state.
Growth
The Spirit Magi summoned by the player has a stat called Growth.
Growth's lower limit is 100 and upper limit is 1000.
Spirit Magi start off at Stage 1 (100 Growth) and grow into the next stage with every 100 Growth gained until they reach Stage 5 (500 Growth).
For every 8 Growth a Spirit Magus has, it gains +1%% Physique. With every stage a Spirit Magus grows, it gains +10%% additional Skill Area and different skill and attribute enhancements:
At Stage 2, Spirit Magi have a +30% chance to use Enhanced Skills.
At Stage 3, the effect of Spirit Magi's Enhanced Skills is enhanced.
At Stage 4, Spirit Magi's Empower Skills gain new effects.

At Stage 5, all the attributes of Spirit Magi are increased, and they gain +50%% additional damage, +10%% additional Skill Area, and +30%% additional Movement Speed. Their Tracking Area also increases.

## Summon
Summon Skills can be used to summon different types of Minions. Minions will automatically cast skills at enemies within their Tracking Area.
Summon Skills can be used to summon different types of Minions. Minions will automatically cast skills at enemies within their Tracking Area. Each type of Minion has a different Tracking Area.
Minions are completely independent of the player and have their own stats. Only effects that explicitly increase Minion stats will be applied to Minions (for example: +10% Minion Damage).
Hits, damage dealt, defeats, etc., of Minions and the player are settled separately, but the defeats of Minions count as the players' defeats when settling XP, drops, etc.
Minion Quantity
The number of Minions a player can have is jointly controlled by the skill's Max Summonable Minions and Max Minions In Map. The skill's Max Summonable Minions cannot exceed the Max Minions In Map.
The Max Summonable Minions of skills that summon the same type of Minion is the highest number among these skills. The total number of Minions summoned by these skills won't exceed this number.

For example: There are 2 Summon Machine Guard skills, of which 1 can summon 6 Machine Guards and the other can summon 4 Machine Guards. In this situation, only a total of 6 Machine Guards can be summoned by these 2 skills.
Minion Types
Minions are divided into Synthetic Troops and Spirit Magi.

## Supreme Showdown - Help
The 21 boss stages in Supreme Showdown represent the ultimate challenge in Torchlight: Infinite.
Each of these 21 stages has a unique boss and enticing rewards, but the difficulty increases with each stage.

In addition to getting basic rewards for clearing the stages, you will also get Star Rating rewards for clearing the stages within the specified time. The quicker you clear higher levels with top star ratings, the better your chances of climbing the rankings.
Supreme Showdown is updated once every season, bringing new rewards and new combat mechanics.
If the character is defeated in Supreme Showdown while playing in Hardcore Mode or Solo Self Found Hardcore Mode, the character will still remain available for the current season.
Rewards for this gameplay can only be claimed in Normal Mode on seasonal servers.

## Synthetic Troop
Synthetic Troops are a type of Minion. Skills that summon Synthetic Troops are typically Active Skills.
Synthetic Troops are a type of Minion. Skills that summon Synthetic Troops are typically Active Skills.
The max number of Synthetic Troop Minions in a map is 6.
Each type of Synthetic Troop has different skills, and their stats receive bonuses from Command-related effects.
Command
The player gains Command after equipping a skill that can be used to summon Synthetic Troops.
The minimum value of Command is -100, the maximum value is 100, and the initial value is 0.
Every point of Command grants Synthetic Troop Minions +3%% additional damage, -2%% additional damage taken, and +2%% Movement Speed, as well as increasing their Tracking Area.

Command is generally not negative, but some special effects will reduce it to lower than 0. When Command is a negative value, the damage bonus granted by each point of Command will always be 0, the Tracking Area will be reduced accordingly, and the Synthetic Troop will be defeated after 5s. When Command is not negative, the time will be refreshed.

When Command is not 0, 13 Command will be reduced/granted (depending on whether the current Command is positive or negative) per second until Command becomes 0 again. For every 10 (or -10) Command increased (or decreased), the amount of Command reduced/granted per second is +7 until the total Command becomes 0.

## TOWER Co. Central Vault - Help
TOWER Co. Central Vault has 3 difficulty levels. Clear the current difficulty to unlock the next.
Hacking the vault requires a Vault Keycard matching the difficulty level.
Hacking is timed. When time runs out, the Chief Security Officer will notice you. Defeat the Chief Security Officer to claim the final reward.
The Chief Security Officer will also appear if you open all Small Strongrooms, fail any Small Strongroom challenge, or end the challenge.
Each Small Strongroom has its own time limit and Robbery Progress target.

## TOWER Sequence
The TOWER Sequence system can be used to research sequences for non-Legendary weapons (including shields). Sequences are special affixes that don't replace existing base affixes.
After the TOWER Sequence feature is unlocked as you progress through the main story, you can perform R&D on weapons (including shields) at [ROOT].
To perform R&D, Hunters must spend a set number of Mods.

Once initiated, each round presents a random selection of colored Chips to choose from. If the selected Chip colors (in any order) match a target sequence, the R&D succeeds, granting the weapon the corresponding effects. If the colors do not match any sequence, the R&D fails.

There are 2 types of R&D: Basic R&D and In-Depth R&D. Basic R&D only requires Hunters to choose 3 Chips, whereas In-Depth R&D requires Hunters to choose 4. Basic R&D only yields Intermediate sequences. Advanced sequences can only be obtained from In-Depth R&D. Each weapon can only have 1 sequence, but Hunters can perform R&D repeatedly until the desired target sequence is obtained.
Consumed materials will not be returned if R&D is interrupted.

## Talent - Help
Talent Points are obtained by leveling up and completing Hunter's Forge. Investing Talent Points in the Talent system provides various powerful buffs.
The Talent Panels of different gods provide different bonuses, which can be mixed and matched freely according to the tags of each Talent Panel.
Talent Nodes are divided into:
Micro Talent Nodes
Medium Talent Nodes
Lv.1 Core Talent Nodes
Lv.2 Core Talent Nodes
The Revert button allows you to revert Talent Nodes and reclaim the Talent Points you've spent.
Reverting Talent Nodes is free before Lv.80.
## Core Talent Node - Help
Core Talent Nodes are the core component of a Talent Panel. A Core Talent Node can only be activated when you have invested enough Talent Points in the corresponding Talent Panel.
You may change your Core Talent Node at any time.
## Talents - Help
Basic Rules:
1. You can select a total of four Talent Panels.
2. The first Talent Panel needs to be selected from a set of six Basic Talent Panels.
3. The second Talent Panel can be selected from four Advanced Talent Panels corresponding to the Basic Talent Panels.
4. You can select the third and the fourth Talent Panel without any restrictions.
About Talent Nodes:
1. Each Talent Panel contains a number of Talent Nodes, and activating Talent Nodes will grant their corresponding effects.
2. Activating Talent Nodes costs corresponding Talent Points.
3. You gain 1 Talent Point for every level and additional Talent Points by completing a set of key quests.
4. Talent Nodes are divided into Minor, Medium, Legendary Medium, and Core Talent Nodes.
5. In order to activate a Medium or Legendary Medium Node, you typically need to activate the preceding Minor Node first.

6. After a certain amount of Talent Nodes have been unlocked on a Talent Panel, Core Talent slots can be unlocked: You can select and activate one from several Core Talents. You can switch the activated Core Talent anytime.
About Forgetting:
1. Activated Talent Nodes can be reset. Resetting costs Oblivion Points. Use Elixir of Oblivion to obtain Oblivion Points.
2. Resetting Talent Nodes does not cost Oblivion Points until you reach Lv. 90.

name: Talent Node Related
text: ## Talent Node Related
Talent Nodes grant you better stats and abilities.
Each Talent Panel includes multiple Talent Nodes.
Activating each Talent Node on the Talent Panel costs Talent Points.
You gain 1 Talent Node every time when you level up. Additionally, you can obtain additional Talent Nodes by completing key quests.
Talent Nodes in the Talent Panel consist of Minor Nodes, Medium Nodes, and Major Nodes.
To unlock a Medium Talent Node, you need to activate its prerequisite Minor Talent Node.

When a certain amount of Medium Nodes has been unlocked on a Talent Panel, Major Talent Nodes can be unlocked: You can select and activate one of the three or four Major Talent Nodes. You can switch the activated Major Talent Node anytime.

## Tangle
While attached to an enemy, it continuously triggers its corresponding Spell Skill.
Tangle will prioritize attaching to the enemy with the highest rarity in the area.
Tangle's base attach range is 8m.
A Tangle is activated upon successful attachment, continuously triggering its corresponding Spell.
If no attachable enemies are in the area, it becomes inactivated.
Summon Skills, Sentry Skills, Channeled Skills, and Restoration Skills cannot be triggered by Tangle.
Tangle's triggering interval is equal to the casting interval of its corresponding spell.
Tangle has a base duration of 8s. When the Tangle limit is reached, using a Tangle Skill replaces the oldest existing Tangle.
The base Max Tangle Quantity is 2. The highest Max Tangle Quantity is 4.

name: Tarot Path
text: ## Tarot Path
Complete the Tarot Trials a certain number of times in Netherrealm stages to enter the Tarot Path and collect Chests of Destiny.
## Tarot Path - Help
1. The Tarot Path unlocks after you complete enough Tarot Trials in the stage.
2. Various Cells exist in the Tarot Path, and you move along the path by using the Notes of Arcana in your hand. When you stop on a Cell, you will trigger the effect of the corresponding Cell.
3. When you stay on a Cell with a Chest of Destiny on it, you will collect it. You can only carry 7 Chests of Destiny at any one time.

4. Chests of Destiny come in 6 rarities: Green, Blue, Purple, Orange, Red, and Rainbow. The rarity of Chests of Destiny can be enhanced by using Notes of Arcana or by triggering random events on the Cells.

5. After collecting Chests of Destiny, Hunters can choose to start Fateful Contest at any time. After completing the corresponding number of Tarot Trials in Fateful Contest, Chests of Destiny can be opened to claim their rewards.

6. There are traps on some Cells in the Tarot Path. Stopping on a Cell with a trap will reduce your Life. When your Life is reduced to zero, Fateful Contest will start, and you won't be able to collect any more Chests of Destiny.
7. When you reach Stage Level 86 (Timemark 8), Chests of Destiny have a chance to drop Rare Fates, Kismets, Dual Kismets, and Star Net.
8. When you reach Stage Level 89 (Profound Timemark 8), Chests of Destiny have a chance to drop Undetermined Fates.

Terra Charge Stacks
Terra Charge stacks can be accumulated. Each stack of Terra Charge needs a period of time to be restored.

The Restoration Duration of each stack of Terra Charge is affected by speed bonuses. The faster the player's speed, the shorter the Restoration Duration of a stack of Terra Charge.
Restoration Duration of each stack of Terra Charge = Base Restoration Duration / (1 + all non-additional bonus percentages).

## The City of Aeterna
Once the construction is complete, the City of Aeterna will become accessible to you, and its terrain will match the completed Aeterna Map.
Defeat the monsters in the City of Aeterna to obtain keys and use them to unlock Candelabrums in reward rooms to obtain rewards and eventually activate the boss in the City of Aeterna.
Once the construction is complete, the City of Aeterna will become accessible to you, and its terrain will match the completed Aeterna Map.
Defeat the monsters in the City of Aeterna to obtain keys and use them to unlock Candelabrums in reward rooms to obtain rewards and eventually activate the boss in the City of Aeterna.
The Boss of the City of Aeterna
The boss of the City of Aeterna will appear when all Candelabrums have been unlocked. Defeat the boss to complete the City of Aeterna.
Boss Strength +1 for every reward room connected.
Boss Strength +2 for every double reward room connected.
Bosses are significantly stronger upon reaching 5/10/15/20 Strength and will also drop additional rewards.
The Stage Level of the City of Aeterna
The stage level of the City of Aeterna is the average level of all Ruins of Aeterna this round. The higher the stage level of the City of Aeterna, the greater the rewards.
Aeterna Tier
Once the City of Aeterna is completed, a City of Aeterna of higher tier will be unlocked. You can then challenge a higher tier next time.
Aeterna tier does not affect Aeterna's terrains or reward room layout but only affects the difficulty level of the monsters and the rewards in it.
The higher the Aeterna tier, the more difficult the stages and the better the rewards.
Clearing the City of Aeterna will increase the highest selectable tier by 5 based on the tier of the current stage
The default highest Aeterna tier upper limit is only 20. The Aeterna tier upper limit can be increased via Psalms of Aeterna.

## The Law Bearer
The Law Bearer
Law Bearer is the boss of Torchlight Infinite season 3.

A new supreme boss, The Law Bearer, has been added to the new season. Defeating Malice Incarnations has a chance to drop the ticket needed to encounter The Law Bearer: the Desire Core. Although The Law Bearer is incredibly powerful, the rewards for defeating it are quite substantial.
Law Bearer: you have violated the will of the Code. I will preside over your trial.
Law Bearer ticket: Desire Core
Desire Core is a ticket to encounter the season 3 boss, The Law Bearer.
Desire Core - Record: Desire Core - Record: used in the Great Void of the Netherrealm to open a portal to challenge the Law Bearer.
Desire Core - Creation: Desire Core - Creation: used in the Great Void of the Netherrealm with Desire Core - Record to open a portal to challenge the Law Bearer at a higher difficulty level.

The Cube of Rapacity will also drop an item known as Desire Core. Desired cores serve as tokens to the challenge new supreme boss called Law Bearer, the Supreme judge of the high court of Desire. This formidable enemy presents a tougher challenge for hunters than ever before. Upon defeating the Law Bearer, players can expect to receive special and Incredibly attractive items. It includes a season's new precious item Unifying Wedge which can be used to restore Divinity slates.
Drops & Rewards

Upon defeating the Law Bearer, players can expect to receive special and Incredibly attractive items. It includes a season's new precious item unifying wedge which can be used to restore Divinity slates.
Season-Exclusive Gameplay: Cube of Rapacity

In the new season, players will encounter the Cube of Rapacity at every stage. Defeating the monsters influenced by the Cube, known as Malice Incarnations, will grant players Desire Crystals. By spending a specific amount of Desire Crystals, players can obtain various rewards from the cube. If fortunate enough, players can draw the Cube of Craving and receive even more valuable rewards. With a touch of greed and luck, it’s possible to double the rewards, but if luck isn’t on your side, you might lose everything.

The new season introduces a unique Season Talent: Avarice Code. By altering the Talent Node method, players can have a completely different season experience: they can choose to have the entire map filled with Malice Incarnations or opt to increase their luck and further pursue the Cube of Craving.
Story

Whoever created the cube must have become a part of it too... according to the legends, this strange cube has been drifting through worlds, devouring everything it touches and converting them into something else. Some worship it because it grants all their wishes. Those who make a sacrifice to it will definitely receive something in return. But some also fear it because they know someone, such as their siblings, parents, or friends, who have never returned after approaching the cube. It has now come to the aember-ravaged Leptis. Here, it is absorbing aember and transforming it into horrific aember monsters never seen before. This has become a new problem for torchlight... of course, it is a problem that can be exploited.

name: Timemark
text: ## Timemark
Netherrealm Timemarks represent their difficulty levels. The higher the Timemark, the greater the difficulty of Netherrealm stages, and the better the drops.
Netherrealm Timemarks represent their difficulty levels. The higher the Timemark, the greater the difficulty of Netherrealm stages, and the better the drops.
You can switch freely among the Timemarks you have reached.
Increase Timemark
In Timemark 1-6, you can unlock the next Timemark by defeating all Plane Watchers in the current Timemark.
In Timemark 7, 8, and Profound Timemark 8, you must defeat the Traveler to unlock the next Timemark.
Offset Degree
Unlike other Timemarks, Timemark 7 and 8 have smaller degrees named Offset Degrees.
Timemark 7 consists of 3 Offset Degrees from 0 to 2. Timemark 8 consists of 3 Offset Degrees from 0 to 3.
The higher the Offset Degree, the harder the Netherrealm stage, and the better the drops.
You can switch freely among the Offset Degrees you have reached.
Defeating either the Plane Watcher or the Traveler unlocks Offset Degrees.

name: Tip
text: 1 | Torchlight is an organization that has been actively fighting against aemberons around the world.
2 | Torchlight is convinced that the Spark is the only hope to eliminate Aember and save the world.
3 | As the basic operating units of Torchlight, a Hunter Squad usually consists of a Hunter and a Crow.
4 | Hunters are the core combatants of Torchlight. Most Hunters are chosen from the Infected.
5 | Adept at using Ember Tech, Crows are responsible for recon and other support missions.
6 | The Church considers those Aember-Infected disqualified to be humans.
7 | Under the influence of Aember, the Infected may lose their minds, and at the same time gain special powers.
8 | The least sane among the Agitoes are Aemberons who know nothing but slaughter, and those who are almost as sane as humans are revered as the Chosen.
9 | As an energy-rich resource, Ember has largely contributed to the development of technology.
10 | Aember, also called Mutated Ember by some scholars, usually appears in the form of gigantic spikes.
11 | Once there's a sprout, Aember will spread uncontrollably and wreak havoc wherever they reach.
12 | Born from Aember, Aemberons are mindless monsters with only instinct to slaughter and destroy. They are merely capable of imitating a few words from those they devour.
13 | After the First Flame was shattered, Aember began to spread.
14 | The First Flame was shattered into several fragments known as the Sparks.
15 | Legend has it that the First Flame can be restored to purge the world of Aember by gathering all Sparks.
16 | The Epoch of Might ended with the Ragnarok.
17 | Arminius the Great died just a thousand days after usurping the throne, but the statue of this final emperor in the history of the human empire still stands in the Holy Capital.
18 | Goblins are keen to collect human throw-aways, especially the old toys.
19 | The Hermann Empire prospered for 800 years with Ember Tech, until a calamity destroyed the Spark.
20 | In Leptis, Ratlins are infamous bandits who would gladly jeopardize their own parents for money.
21 | Active in every corner of the continent, Ratlins are scums who pursue wealth and power by any means necessary.
22 | Deep within the desert live the people of Ichi who behave like cats. They are an ancient race who shoulder the Curse of Eternal Night.
23 | The Ancient Ichi once made an artificial sun from pure gold, and it brought radiant and seemingly endless daytime to them.
24 | Shadowborn are born within the natural hotbed formed from the volcano cave and the dragon's remains. They lack intelligence and are solely driven by their instinct to chase the sun.
25 | St. Duran Church locates at the center of Imperial Plaza, next to the Royal Garden and the Lost City.
26 | Although the leader of St. Duran Church is Archbishop Derrick, the day-to-day operation has been delegated to Vicar Bishop Keegan.
27 | The Knights of Derain is the private army of the Church who answer directly to the Bishops.
28 | A Spark is enshrined in the relic halls of the heavily guarded St. Duran Church Headquarters.
29 | Thanks to the Spark, the Church created a sanctum for its followers on the Aember land.
30 | The Church reveres the power of nature and preaches the evil of Ember. They consider the Disqualified as a symbol of unholiness.
31 | Refugees rejected by the Church settled in the ruins of the outer city, calling themselves the Forsaken.
32 | The Forsaken built the Lost City upon the ruins and armed themselves with Ember Tech.
33 | The Lost City and the Church are separated by a rampart known as the Wailing Wall.
34 | The Lost City is a place of violence and crimes where new gangs emerge and disappear every day.
35 | The Clockwork Core can open spacetime rifts to other mirror worlds.
36 | Every Crow carries Flame Elementium to control their mutated Hunters.
37 | The Infected will gradually lose themselves under the Aember's corrosion until they turn into monsters that are called Agitoes.
38 | A Hunter and their Crow partners are connected by a unique Pact that portrays their mutual choice and recognition.
39 | Because of the Pact between Hunters and Crows, their emotions and feelings are bound together.
40 | The nature of the Hunter-Crow Pact is a soul link created with Spark Fragments.
41 | Once a pact is formed, a Crow may use Spark Fragments to convey their personal will to help their Hunter partner resist Aemberization.
42 | Once the Pact is sealed, the Hunter and the Crow will accompany each other for the rest of their lives.
43 | In the First Flame of the world, Six Gods were born.
44 | No one has ever seen the gods, but their footprints are found everywhere.
45 | According to legend, every waypoint you see today used to be a rivet nailed into the ground by gods during the Epoch of Might.
46 | Under the influence of the First Flame, dragons used to be unusually powerful creatures that reigned and enslaved others.
47 | For offending the dragons, dwarves were banished to the underground, so they would never be illuminated by the First Flame.
48 | The First Flame was originally located in Sol'Quinn until dwarves stole it and won the battle of Ragnarok.
49 | The Epoch of Hunting was a dark age when the world was shrouded in darkness like today.
50 | During the Epoch of War, kingdoms and heroes rose, and the civilizations developed rapidly.
51 | The conflicts during the Epoch of War last for thousands of years until a devastating flood put an end to everything.
52 | The flood was still raging on the ground, yet Utopia was created in the sky.
53 | During the Epoch of Knowledge, a failed creation that had nothing to offer was created-humans.
54 | After Utopia was ruined in the hands of humans, the floating island fell as the Tower of Celestials collapsed.
55 | The Epoch of Knowledge was erased from history when all research results were burned by human hands.
56 | Humans rose to power in the Epoch of Deception.
57 | The emergence of Ember Tech opened the curtain of the Epoch of Machines
58 | At the beginning of the universe, there was no one. No spacetime, nor rise or fall.
59 | Time was the only point where mirror worlds and planes crossed.
60 | The Creator split his will into countless First Flames, then placed them in different worlds.
61 | Behemoths carried the First Flames into each mirror world and brought the breath of life to the withered lands.
62 | Millions of years passed, and even the Behemoths fell. Their remains became Ember, yet the First Flames burned still.
63 | The First Flame was the legacy of the Creator and the seed that bred the new gods.
64 | The Clockwork Core opened the gates to different spacetimes, yet it invited ambitions and conflicts.
65 | Ember Tech brought human civilization to a new era.
66 | Behemoths and the First Flame formed the original new world.
67 | Mankind worships the First Flame because it expelled the darkness of obscurity and brought the light of civilization.
68 | Later generations built High Towers to enshrine the First Flame, so that it could expel the barbarism further away.
69 | Ember is a common mineral resource that can be purified to obtain Ember Crystals that contain tremendous energy.
70 | Aember is the product of the decayed Ember. It represents the undoing of everything.
71 | Aember is strongly aggressive. It parasitizes and assimilates almost everything.
72 | The king of the desert transported a massive amount of gold to the central continent in exchange for their emperor's promised Ember Machine to build Desert Lamps that light up the Eternal Night.
73 | The thriving beliefs in this world are the traces left by the advents of gods.
74 | Albert the dwarf travels the continent with his shovel. His adventure notes are not known for being detailed, but for quick updates and abundant contents.
75 | The Six Gods/Goddesses: God of Might, Goddess of Hunting, Goddess of Knowledge, God of War, Goddess of Deception, and God of Machines.
76 | In the boundless desert, Ancient Ichi once stood tall and strong. Its brilliance used to be as bright and hot as the sun.
77 | Before the Eternal Night, Lakhouma was still a land of prosperity.
78 | According to legend among tomb raiders, there is an ancient city of gold hidden in the desert.
79 | Albert always goes on ahead, and his brave companion, Hannpy, usually meets us on the road.
1001 | Pay attention to skill tags and build your characters around them.
1002 | Auras provide steady enhancements at the cost of sealing a portion Mana or Life.
1003 | Trinkets such as rings, necklaces, and belts provide balanced offensive and defensive stats.
1004 | You can use Spell Skills while wielding any weapon, but some of them are better suited for using Spell Skills.
1005 | Equipping two One-Handed Melee or Ranged weapons is known as Dual Wielding, which grants additional buffs.
1006 | Balance your offensive and defensive stats to find the playstyle that suits you best.
1007 | Resistances are essential for survival. Keep dying from normal Firebolts? Stack Fire Resistance!
1008 | Before you can pick a Talent, you must have all of its prerequisites.
1009 | You'll gain particularly powerful abilities from each Talent Panel.
1010 | For your third Talent Panel, you may pick abilities from another deity. Be creative while discovering your own unique build.
1011 | After Lv. 90, you can use the Elixir of Oblivion to change your Talents at any time.
1012 | Hero Traits are particularly powerful. Make sure to put them to good use.
1013 | Match your Hero Traits with additional skills and items to create synergy.
1014 | If you have too many pieces of gear, you may recycle them in your Inventory or at a Trader.
1015 | Approach an item that dropped and click the name frame in the upper-right corner to pick it up and put it into the Inventory.
1016 | There are countless ways of combining different skills. Each may give you an unexpected surprise.
1017 | The recommended talents suit your current hero well most of the time.
1018 | Remember, you need to activate an Aura Skill after it's equipped.
1019 | Attack Skills are usually better paired with weapons with a higher DPS value.
1020 | All Attack Skills require specific weapon types. It's essential to select a suitable weapon.
1021 | Resistances reduce the corresponding type of damage you take and are essential for your survival. It's best to maximize them.
1022 | Warcries are way more impactful than you thought.
1023 | Don't forget to use your Compound Tonics when you are in danger.
1024 | The minimap in the upper-left corner is very helpful while exploring.
1025 | Each Ailment has its own characteristics. Remember to use them when you can.
1026 | Before Lv. 90, you can change your Talents at any time.
1027 | Gear with a higher item level can be used to craft higher-level affixes, and gear with these affixes usually has unique drop frames.
1029 | Your character gains 1 Energy per level, which allows you to equip more skills.
1030 | Brand Divinity Slates to obtain more strength from the same God.
1031 | Corrosion is both risky and rewarding. It's your choice to make.
1032 | Player can have at most 6 Synthetic Troop Minions and 2 Spirit Magus Minions.
1033 | Elites refer to rare monsters and bosses. These opponents are worth fighting.
1034 | The item filter can filter and display the most valuable items you currently own to help you explore Leptis better.
1035 | Filter rules can be selected in the settings. Remember to select suitable filter rules.
1036 | The higher the tier of gear pre-fixes and suffixes, the greater the stat bonuses granted by the affixes.
1037 | Netherrealm stages covered by Confusion Cards will have +100% additional Drop Quantity.
1038 | When farming Netherrealm stages, use a Pactspirit build with 3 Drop Pactspirits to gain a better yield.
1039 | Before entering a Netherrealm map, max out your base affixes using Netherrealm Resonance to gain a better yield.
1040 | Don't forget to swap to the right Drop Pactspirit when playing different season-exclusive gameplay.
1041 | When challenging powerful foes, utilizing a Pactspirit build with 3 Battle Pactspirits will make things a lot easier.

1042 | Cooldown and Interval are the downtime you face after casting a skill. While Cooldown can be affected by Cooldown Recovery Speed, Interval is set in stone and cannot be shortened by any form of upgrade.
1043 | You can recycle Compasses that you don't need into Fluorescent Memories. Collect 3 to exchange them for 1 random Compass from the Spacetime Wanderer.
1044 | After the skill level exceeds Lv. 30, the Base Damage no longer changes, but for every level exceeded, the skill +6% additional damage (multiplies).
1045 | Don't blindly pursue higher values on the panel as real battles are affected by complex mechanisms and affixes.
1046 | Empower effects allow Invincible No.2 to deal more damage, but in a real battle, you'll need to consider whether the duration is long enough to last until the next cooldown.
1047 | Go to Settings - Graphics to adjust the brightness for a better visual experience.
1048 | Resistance is the most important Survival stat. Hunters have a Max Resistance of 60% by default.
1049 | To unlock a second Soul Candle slot, you'll need to use Pages of Aeterna in Psalms of Aeterna.
1050 | The Legendary Divinity Slate "When Sparks Set the Prairie Ablaze" drops everywhere in Netherrealm. The Fluorescent Memory used to exchange it can be obtained in specified Netherrealm planes.
1051 | Skill levels can be reset directly in the Skill Inventory.
1052 | If you want to use another build, go to Pro Builds to see what others think first.
1053 | Go to Settings - Battle to choose whether you want to activate features such as Auto Channel, Auto Aim, and Immediate Cast for your current skills.
1054 | Using a skill or triggering a skill are both referred to as casting a skill in the game.
1055 | Use Divinity Stones in the Blessings from Gods at Spacetime Wanderer to get high-value Legendary gear.
1056 | Compared to "+% damage," seeking "+% additional damage" will usually bring greater benefits.
1057 | The Trade House is unlocked when the Hunter reaches Lv. 60 and supports Advanced Search. It is an important tool for Hunters to complete their builds.
1058 | If there is a Lv. 80 or higher character on the account in the current season, when creating a new character, Time Transition Capsule can be used to skip the main story.
1059 | The main story is only a small part of the game. Go challenge the Netherrealm!
1060 | While progressing in the main story, Hunters will encounter many Treasure Troves to help them obtain lots of XP and specified Legendary gear in the early game.
1061 | Most in-game items can be traded in the Trade House.
1062 | Equipping two One-Handed Melee or Ranged weapons is known as Dual Wielding, which grants additional buffs.
1063 | Team mode and solo mode consume the same amount of map materials, but all members of a team share challenge attempts.
1064 | While in team mode, bonuses from Pactspirits, Trait Cards, etc., will only be affected by the Hunter who activates the current stage.
1065 | Only some items can be gifted between friends, and gifted items can't be traded or gifted again.
1066 | Team mode has various drop distribution modes such as Free Distribution, Team Distribution, and System Distribution.
1067 | Do you have too many drops? Use an official filter or custom filter based on your character's level.

name: Trait Decks and Card Library
text: ## Trait Decks and Card Library - Help
1. A Trait Deck can consist of up to 10 Trait Cards from the Trait Card Library.

2. Whenever you open a Netherrealm stage in a plane, all affix effects of all cards in the Trait Deck will be applied to that stage. The exceptions are stages with the Plane Watcher, Traveler, and Great Void in them.
3. At the end of each round of Chaos Invasion, players can choose to add a new Trait Card to the Card Library or upgrade 1 existing Trait Card.
4. While accumulating Confusion Cards, there are also opportunities to select additional Trait Cards.
5. Some Trait Cards can only be obtained at a higher Timemark.
6. When there are fewer than 10 cards in the Trait Card Library, newly obtained Trait Cards will be automatically added to the Trait Deck in the next round of Chaos Invasion.
7. When there are more than 10 cards in the Trait Card Library, players can customize the Trait Deck and select any 10 Trait Cards in the Trait Card Library to add to the deck.
8. When there are more than 10 cards in the Trait Card Library, players can adjust the Trait Deck at any time. The adjusted Trait Deck will take effect when the next round of Chaos Invasion starts.

## Trauma
An Ailment that deals Physical Damage Over Time.
Trauma deals Physical Damage Over Time and has a default duration of 4s.
When inflicted on an enemy, Trauma deals Physical Damage Over Time equal to the Base Trauma Damage every second to the target.
By default, the maximum number of Trauma stacks is 1. When multiple Trauma effects act on a unit simultaneously, only the Trauma effect with the highest damage will take effect.
The duration of Trauma effects that deal more damage will not be affected by subsequently inflicted Trauma effects that deal less damage.

name: Trial Goddess of Hunting Safari
text: ## Trial: Goddess of Hunting (Safari)
In Netherrealm stages, a Statue of Hunting will be spawned at the stage start.

After Trial: Goddess of Hunting begins, Safari Bosses in the stage will receive blessings from the Goddess of Hunting. When they are defeated, the Stage Final Boss will receive 1 additional blessing from the Goddess of Hunting

name: Trial of Divinity
text: ## Trial of Divinity - Help
1. Trial of Divinity is not affected by any Pactspirit Drop Quantity bonuses.
2. Every level advanced increases the Drop Quantity at the end of the trial.
3. Every 10 levels advanced significantly increases the difficulty of subsequent trials and the Drop Quantity at the end of the trial.
4. The chances of an exclusive Legendary gear or related Fluorescent Memory Shards dropping increases with the Drop Quantity at the end of the trial.
5. The chance of a Divinity Emblem dropping in Six Gods is affected by Drop Quantity bonuses.

6. If you fail during the Trial of Divinity, you have the option to either challenge again based on the remaining challenge attempts for this trial or leave the gameplay area during the trial and wait for the trial to end in the safe zone in the lower left corner. If you choose to leave, you can still claim the rewards you've earned according to your progress.If you run out of challenge attempts, you will not be able to claim any rewards. Claiming the rewards will conclude the current challenge.

## Twinightmare - Help
Basic Rules
1. You will encounter Dream Lotuses in the stage. Interact with them to have a Sweet Dream or a Nightmare.

2. If you have a Sweet Dream, you'll need to kill the Sleepwalkers to awaken the Sweet Dream Lotus. Interact with it to select Dream Omens to enhance your Dream Bubbles and make all upcoming Nightmares more dangerous.
3. If you enter a Nightmare, you'll need to survive the trials of the Nightmare. Pass the trial, and the Dream Bubbles' rewards will become real.
4. Your chance of entering a Nightmare increases with every floor advanced in a Sweet Dream until you finally enter a Nightmare.
Dream Bubble
1. All rewards that can be obtained in Twinightmare are collectively referred to as Dream Bubbles. These rewards will become real after you pass the trials of the Nightmare.
2. Bubbles have two attributes: quality and type. Read the text description of Sweet Dream Omen for the specific details.
3. Starting from Netherrealm Timemark 7, Orange and better bubbles have a chance to drop Profound Dream Talking. When used, this item adds advanced Dream affixes to gear during Dream Interpretation.
Dream Omen
1. There are 2 types of Dream Omens: Sweet Dream Omens and Nightmare Omens.
2. Sweet Dream Omens will change your Dream Bubbles in various ways, such as by changing the quality of bubbles, adding or removing bubbles, changing the type of bubbles, etc.

2.1 When choosing an omen for the first time in each round of dreams, the Sweet Dream Omen that appears is called the Fundamentals of a Sweet Dream, which usually takes effect multiple times in subsequent choices or when entering a Nightmare.
2.2 The Sweet Dream Omens that appear from the second time onward usually take effect immediately.

2.3 When a Sweet Dream Omen takes effect, unless specified otherwise, situations where it can't actually take effect will not be automatically avoided. For example: a Sweet Dream Omen that tries to improve the quality of bubbles may still target the highest quality bubble even though the bubble's quality can't actually be improved. Sweet Dream Omens that try to increase the number of bubbles will still attempt to add more bubbles even if the Vision is full and the changes can't actually take effect. So please be careful when choosing your Sweet Dream Omens!
3. Nightmare Omens intensify your Nightmares in various ways. Upon entering a Nightmare, all the Nightmare Omens you've selected will take effect together.
4. Every Sweet Dream Omen is accompanied by 1 Nightmare Omen. When selecting your Sweet Dream Omens, please check its accompanying Nightmare Omen carefully!
Nightmare Trial
1. In a Nightmare, you must kill all the Nightmare Roots to make your dreams come true.

2. Whenever you are killed in a Nightmare, you will randomly lose 1/6 of your total Dream Bubbles (rounded down). The portion that has been rounded down will be recorded. Once the total rounded-down portion reaches 1, an additional bubble will be deducted the next time you are killed, the remaining rounded-down portion less than one will be recorded, and the process will keep repeating.
3. Bubbles will not be deducted immediately. Instead, all bubble deductions will take effect when settling the successful or unsuccessful escape from the Nightmare.

4. The Nightmare stage will inherit 1 base drop buff of the map in this round of the mode (excluding Netherrealm Resonance, Compass, and card buffs), and the stage level will be equal to the average of the levels of all maps in this round of the mode.

name: Type Changed
text: ## Type Changed
Only valid after an actual change in type.
For example: Attempting to change a bubble's type yet its type remains unchanged. This is not considered a change in type.

name: Type Conversion
text: ## Type Conversion
All Drop Quantity bonuses are applied before the conversion. Converted items are no longer affected by these bonuses.
This type of attributes refers to things like "Gear drops have a X% chance to become Flame Fuel," "Gear drops have a X% chance to become Flame Elementium," etc.
All Drop Quantity bonuses are applied before the conversion. Converted items are no longer affected by these bonuses.

Note: If the total conversion chance for a type of item exceeds 100%, the conversion chance will be weighted so that the total chance remains 100%. For example, if "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Fuel" and "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Ember" are applied at the same time, the gear drop will have a 50% chance to become 1 set of Fuel and 50% chance to become 1 set of Ember.
Calculation (using the conversion of a piece of gear to Fuel as an example)

Example 1: If a certain drop originally has a 100% chance to drop 10 pieces of gear, with "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Fuel", there is a 100% chance to drop 10 sets of Fuel (this Fuel can be any Fuel item, such as Flame Sand x1, Flame Elementium x1, Flame Elementium x10, etc., and the same applies below)

Example 2: If a certain drop originally has a 100% chance to drop 10 pieces of gear, with "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Fuel" and "+100% Drop Quantity," there is a 100% chance to drop 20 sets of Fuel

Example 3: If a certain drop originally has a 100% chance to drop 10 pieces of gear, with "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Fuel" and "+100% gear Drop Quantity," there is a 100% chance to drop 20 sets of Fuel

Example 4: If a certain drop originally has a 100% chance to drop 10 pieces of gear, with "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Fuel" and "+100% Fuel Drop Quantity," there is a 100% chance to drop 10 sets of Fuel

name: Using, Triggering, Casting, and Activating Skills
text: ## Using, Triggering, Casting, and Activating Skills
Players can cast and activate skills. Casting skills can be further divided into using and triggering skills.
Players can cast and activate skills. Casting skills can be further divided into using and triggering skills.
Cast
Using and triggering a skill are both ways to cast a skill.
Use
The player's action taken to press or hold down the skill button to create a skill effect is called using a skill.
Only Active Skills can be used.
Trigger
Certain effects can trigger other skills. Triggered skills generate skill effects directly without any action.
Only Active Skills and some special skills can be triggered. Attack Mobility, Channeled, and some other special skills (such as Bombard) cannot be triggered.
Activate
The player's action taken to click a skill's activation button or the Activate All button on the Skill panel is called activating a skill.
Only Passive Skills can be activated.

name: Vigil Gameplay
text: ## Vigil Gameplay - Help
Gameplay Info:
After starting the Vigil, you must defeat the Wraiths swarming around the Undead Vigil Procession within the time limit.
In a standard Vigil, waves of Wraiths spawn at set intervals. However, Wraiths will stop spawning if too many of them are on the field.
During the Vigil, your Guiding Lantern draws Wraiths in and signals the current battle intensity.

Guiding Lantern: Stable (Blue)-The faster you defeat Wraiths, the faster they spawn. Guiding Lantern: Flickering (Yellow)-Wraiths are starting to pile up. Thin them out before it gets worse. Guiding Lantern: Overloaded (Red)-Too many Wraiths are on the field. Spawning is paused. Clear them fast or risk losing rewards. At the Usher Mortuary, you can spend Remnant Souls to awaken Relics. Once awakened, there's a chance Vigil Anomalies and Noble Coffins will appear during runs-some of them can shake up the rules and greatly improve drops.
Usher Mortuary:
Usher Mortuary is the Vigil gameplay's progression system. This is where you invest Remnant Souls to unlock Vigil Anomalies, Noble Coffins, or upgrade your gameplay effects.
Every time you finish a Vigil run (win or lose), you earn 1 Remnant Soul, up to the cap.
You can cancel or reset any awakened Relic anytime, and all Remnant Souls are refunded in full.
Relic Effect changes only take effect when you enter the next map.

## Void Chart
Through Void Chart, you can customize your Netherrealm stage experience to a certain extent.
Through Void Chart, you can customize your Netherrealm stage experience to a certain extent.
There are dozens of different Talent Constellations in the Void Chart.
By spending Star Talents and Prime Star Talents, you can activate any Talent Node within a Talent Constellation.
Affixes on activated Talent Nodes will be added to Netherrealm stages.
Obtaining Star Talents
Star Talents are primarily obtained by defeating unique Plane Watchers.
A small number of Star Talents must be obtained through the Path of Progression.
Obtaining Prime Star Talents
Prime Star Talents are obtained by defeating Travelers.

## Void Sea Flame - Help
1. In the stage affected by Void Pirates, some monsters will drop Void Sea Flames when they are defeated. Void Sea Seal will appear after the stage is completed.
2. Place Void Sea Flames into the Void Sea Seal to lure over Void Pirates. Defeat 3 waves of Void Pirates to reveal 3 Seal Whispers.
3. Different Void Sea Flames have different effects. Some make Void Pirates give additional drops, while others affect the type of Seal Whisper that is revealed after defeating Void Pirates.

4. The number of monsters that can drop Void Seas Flames increases with the difficulty of the stage, and monsters will only drop Gold Void Sea Flames in Netherrealm stages played at Timemark 7 and Timemark 8.

5. If there are unselected Seal Whispers when a Void Sea Flame is placed into the Void Sea Seal or the Void Sea Terminal is already open, the additional Void Sea Flame effects selected this time will not take effect, and the drop results of Void Sea Flames in the stage at this Timemark will not change.

## Void Sea Terminal - Help
1. At the Void Sea Terminal, pick from the revealed Seal Whispers to apply their affix effects to the Terminal.
2. Seal Whispers come in three types: Whisper of Wealth, Whisper of Armament, and Whisper of Wonder. When no Void Sea Flames are in effect, each reveal is guaranteed to contain one of each type.
3. After you add six Seal Whispers, the Void Sea Terminal opens. You can then challenge it to get Void Sea Treasures.
4. If any Seal Whisper remains unselected, no new ones will appear until you finish choosing for this round.

name: Vorax Exchange
text: ## Vorax Exchange - Help
Exchange for various Organs and Sutures in Organ Exchange.
In Vorax Exchange, exchange different types of Vorax Amputated Limbs for Vorax Gear of corresponding item levels. Vorax Amputated Limbs can be obtained by breaking down Vorax Gear.
Vorax Amputated Limb - Decayed: Obtained by breaking down a piece of Lv. 86-88 Vorax Gear and can be exchanged for a piece of Lv. 86 Vorax Gear.
Vorax Amputated Limb - Engorged: Obtained by breaking down a piece of Lv. 89 Vorax Gear and can be exchanged for a piece of Lv. 89 Vorax Gear.
Vorax Amputated Limb - Throbbing: Obtained by breaking down a piece of Lv. 90 Vorax Gear and can be exchanged for a piece of Lv. 90 Vorax Gear.

name: Whirlwind Blade
text: SS14Season
Whirlwind Blade
Spell Physical Persistent Area Projectile Horizontal
Main Stat:
Intelligence
Mana Cost
Cast Speed
Cooldown
Effectiveness of added damage
Simple

Casts the skill and fires 1 Projectile that always Penetrates in the target direction, dealing 400-667 Spell Physical Damage. The Projectile deals damage once every 0.25s and stops on the spot after traveling a fixed distance or hitting an Elite.
After casting this skill, casting it again will recall the Projectile that has been fired, but that cast is not deemed to have been cast again.

Projectiles can only be fired again after all previous Projectiles have been recalled. Projectiles will be automatically recalled after 5s. If a Projectile is more than 40m away from the character, the Projectile will be forcibly removed and won't need to be recalled.
The Projectiles fired by this skill can hit the same enemy.
Details
Whirlwind Blade:
Deals 400-667 Spell Physical Damage.
This skill fires 1 Projectile in its base state.
It deals damage once every 0.25s.
Projectiles from this skill always Penetrate
Projectiles will be automatically recovered after 5 s.
The Projectiles shot by the skill can hit the same enemy.
The skill's Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 75%.

1. Starting from Day 9, Chest of Folklores will have a chance to drop Rare Activation Mediums.
2. The Drop Quantity of Activation Mediums and Mistville Intel is not affected by any Drop Quantity bonuses.

3. The Drop Quantity of other items is only affected by the Drop Quantity bonuses of the gameplay, including Mistosis, Chest of Folklores Drop Quantity bonuses, and Drop Quantity bonuses of the month.
4. The Drop Quantity of Infection Progress in Netherrealm is not affected by any Pactspirit's Drop Quantity bonuses.

## Wilt
An Ailment that deals Erosion Damage Over Time.
Wilt deals Erosion Damage Over Time with a default duration of 1.5s.
When inflicted on an enemy, each stack of Wilt deals Erosion Damage Over Time equal to the Base Wilt Damage every second to the target.
By default, the maximum number of Wilt stacks is 30.
After reaching max stacks of Wilt, subsequent stacks of Wilt inflicted will replace the Wilt stacks with the shortest remaining duration.

name: Youga
text: ## Spacetime Witness /3

Spacetime Illusion: Youga can create a Twisted Spacetime around himself to gain multiple buffs when staying inside it. When in the Twisted Spacetime, he can summon a shadow who can cast skills independently to assist him.

Spacetime Elapse: When encountering enemies, Youga releases the Twisted Spacetime and deals Damage Over Time to them. When he moves the Twisted Spacetime, it applies Spacetime Turbulence on enemies within it, speeding up and enhancing Damage Over Time.

The Ultimate One: Don't bother with the others. The most perfect "me" is right before your eyes. I can fill the Clockwork Core with Spell Tangle, and with a snap of my fingers, magic pours out on its own. Land a few Critical Strikes, and my Cooldowns melt away. I slip through time and space at will, turning certain defeat into victory. I dominate. I conquer. I reign. I am the final master of countless worlds and ages.

name: Berserker Rehan | Anger
text: Rehan will gain Rage upon hitting a target or taking damage and then gain damage from Rage. At Max Rage, Rehan will automatically enter the Berserk state and have his stats significantly increased.

name: Berserker Rehan | Seething Silhouette
text: Blessed by the Ancestor Spirit, Rehan has a chance to summon the Seething Spirit to assist him in fights. The Seething Spirit will cast the Main Skill to help Rehan fight powerful enemies.

name: Divineshot Carino | Ranger of Glory
text: Carino is a character specialized in projectiles' special ammo. When using Projectile Skills, Carino will use different special ammo combos to assist in firing and enhance the skills at the cost of ammo.

name: Divineshot Carino | Lethal Flash
text: Lethal Flash centers around controlling projectile range. It changes projectile forms to match the situation, and boosts damage and survivability through Deflection.

name: Divineshot Carino | Zealot of War
text: Carino's combat style revolves around switching shooting modes and managing heat. Carino can change modes on the fly to adapt to various situations and gain a high damage bonus by consuming ammo. However, he'll also be forced to reload when his muzzle overheats.

name: Cateye Erika | Wind Stalker
text: During combat, Erika can dodge attacks and launch a powerful strike through her swift movements and agile positioning. After moving a certain distance, Erika will gain Stalker, move even faster, have a higher chance to Multistrike, and deal more damage.

name: Cateye Erika | Lightning Shadow
text: Utilizes lightning-powered Ember Tech to gain massive buffs.
Inflicts Numbed on the enemies within range through Feline Figure and effectively increases damage.

name: Cateye Erika|Vendetta's Sting
text: Transformed into an assassin, Erika darts swiftly through enemy lines, unleashing a flurry of swift and deadly melee strikes.

name: Escapist Bing | Blast Nova
text: Bing can pack a large number of projectiles into his exquisite and dangerous bombs, dealing deadly damage by throwing multiple bombs at once and detonating them in an instant.

name: Escapist Bing | Creative Genius
text: Bing carries two Inspiration Machines, charging them with Whimsy Essence and Ingenuity Essence. He uses Whimsy Explosion to increase Spell Damage taken by enemies and Ingenuity Overload to unleash devastating Spell Bursts!

name: Frostfire Gemma | Flame of Pleasure
text: Casts Purgatory, greatly weakening enemies within it and increasing your damage dealt.

name: Frostfire Gemma | Frostbitten Heart
text: When using Cold Skills, Gemma will gain Cold Energy, which will increase Cold Damage and Frostbite Chance. At Max Cold Energy, Gemma will cast Cold Pulse and deal massive Cold Damage.

name: Frostfire Gemma | Ice-Fire Fusion
text: The forces of fire and ice fuse within Gemma's body, reinforcing each other. When using Cold and Fire Skills, Gemma will gain Fusion Energy. At Max Fusion Energy, Gemma can cast Frostfire Rampage to increase her damage.

name: Oracle Thea | Wisdom of The Gods
text: Thea is capable of gaining and using Tenacity, Focus, and Agility Blessings skillfully. She can enhance the incoming God's Boon and gain buffs at the cost of Blessings.

name: Oracle Thea | Incarnation of The Gods
text: Thea can use blessings to summon a Divine Realm in the mortal world. When outside the Divine Realm, Thea can fight against enemies with the Agility Blessing. When inside the Divine Realm, she will fight against powerful enemies with the Tenacity Blessing.

name: Oracle Thea | Blasphemer
text: Thea can convert Blessings into a sacrilegious power that increases the Erosion Damage dealt to a single enemy and can cause Erosion Explosions with a large area of effect.

name: Spacetime Witness Youga | Spacetime Illusion
text: Youga can create a Twisted Spacetime around himself to gain multiple buffs when staying inside it. When in the Twisted Spacetime, he can summon a shadow who can cast skills independently to assist him.

name: Spacetime Witness Youga | Spacetime Elapse
text: When encountering enemies, Youga releases the Twisted Spacetime and deals Damage Over Time to them. When he moves the Twisted Spacetime, it applies Spacetime Turbulence on enemies within it, speeding up and enhancing Damage Over Time.

name: Spacetime Witness Youga | The Ultimate One
text: Don't bother with the others. The most perfect "me" is right before your eyes. I can fill the Clockwork Core with Spell Tangle, and with a snap of my fingers, magic pours out on its own. Land a few Critical Strikes, and my Cooldowns melt away. I slip through time and space at will, turning certain defeat into victory. I dominate. I conquer. I reign. I am the final master of countless worlds and ages.

name: Commander Moto | Order Calling
text: Moto is capable of leading his Synthetic Troop to fight. He will inflict Overload on Minions frequently to increase their Life, Speed, Attack, and other stats to let this iron army fight for him.

name: Commander Moto | Charge Calling
text: Moto commands the Synthetic Troop to dash toward enemies and makes them self-destruct. When in combat, Moto can use Overload to quickly summon Synthetic Troops to increase the explosion efficiency and enhance combat capability.

name: Lightbringer Rosa | High Court Chariot
text: You can use Holy Domain to force enemies to gather together and gain buffs when you're in the Holy Domain.

name: Lightbringer Rosa | Unsullied Blade
text: Increase your Mana to deal lots of Elemental Damage to enemies inside the Realm of Mercury.

name: The Forsaken Iris | Growing Breeze
text: Fight with Spirit Magi and give them buffs to speed up their growth.

name: The Forsaken Iris | Vigilant Breeze
text: Iris merges with a Spirit Magus to enter the Vigilant state, fighting enemies with Spirit Magus Skills and granting Spirit Magi with Breeze to enhance their damage.

name: Tide Whisper Selena | Sing with the Tide
text: In Bard form, you can encase skills in bubbles while moving. When a bubble bursts, the skill within is cast at that location, creating a Tide. In Loud Song form, you can deal significantly increased damage when standing in the Tide.

name: Tide Whisper: Selena | Dance of the Deep
text: Makes Terra Skills follow you as you move. Dance with them to gain multiple Terra Skill-related bonuses and auto-use your Main Terra Skill. Different Dance Steps also grant Movement Speed, Survival, and Damage buffs.

name: Scent Weaver Sage|Licorice Note
text: Sage is a master of alchemy capable of brewing potent Elixirs to unlock her potential and take down even the most formidable foes. In battle, she can adapt her recipes on the fly, mixing special Elixirs to provide versatile support.

text: The moon is far beyond reach, yet its edge can still come for you.

name: Recommendation Letter - Relentless Claws
text: Keep running. Faster.
Only when the prey had exhausted its last ounce of strength did she leap down gracefully from the towering cliff.

name: Recommendation Letter - Howl of the Pack
text: A clear, piercing howl rides the wind, making you think the night holds only one lone wolf. But when you turn toward the sound, you may find yourself already snared in her trap.

name: Recommendation Letter - Iron Curtain
text: Very well. This time, I will bear it all.

name: Recommendation Letter - Wild Barbarian King
text: A true king commands supreme might, shattering all that is unbreakable and crushing all that is unreasonable.

name: Recommendation Letter - Vessel of Sin
text: The wounds on this massive body have never truly healed, and from them surges a boundless torrent of strength. Whoever claims his armor inherits his power. And his pain.

name: Recommendation Letter - Curl-Tailed Sentinel
text: Dying alone's the old-school way. Down in the sewers, numbers win. So, you in?

name: Recommendation Letter - Plague
text: Easy, easy. No need to rush. Let me just set loose a few starving black rats... and a plague that creeps in silence.

name: Recommendation Letter - Rampaging Rat
text: Enough talk! Eat this arrow!

name: Recommendation Letter - Golden-Mane Bastion
text: A golden wall towering over the scorched earth, keeping usurpers' ambitions at bay.

name: Recommendation Letter - Scion of Light
text: Neither ritual nor crown bequeaths our authority. My lineage, ancient and luminous, commands by birthright a majesty that makes everything unclean recoil.

name: Recommendation Letter - Chant of Conquest
text: From the grasslands beneath our feet, we trample cities and thrones, charging ceaselessly toward the boundless lands touched by the blazing sun!

1 | Torchlight is an organization that has been actively fighting against aemberons around the world.

15 | Legend has it that the First Flame can be restored to purge the world of Aember by gathering all Sparks.

18 | Goblins are keen to collect human throw-aways, especially the old toys.

20 | In Leptis, Ratlins are infamous bandits who would gladly jeopardize their own parents for money.
21 | Active in every corner of the continent, Ratlins are scums who pursue wealth and power by any means necessary.
22 | Deep within the desert live the people of Ichi who behave like cats. They are an ancient race who shoulder the Curse of Eternal Night.
23 | The Ancient Ichi once made an artificial sun from pure gold, and it brought radiant and seemingly endless daytime to them.
24 | Shadowborn are born within the natural hotbed formed from the volcano cave and the dragon's remains. They lack intelligence and are solely driven by their instinct to chase the sun.

28 | A Spark is enshrined in the relic halls of the heavily guarded St. Duran Church Headquarters.
29 | Thanks to the Spark, the Church created a sanctum for its followers on the Aember land.

31 | Refugees rejected by the Church settled in the ruins of the outer city, calling themselves the Forsaken.
32 | The Forsaken built the Lost City upon the ruins and armed themselves with Ember Tech.
33 | The Lost City and the Church are separated by a rampart known as the Wailing Wall.
34 | The Lost City is a place of violence and crimes where new gangs emerge and disappear every day.
35 | The Clockwork Core can open spacetime rifts to other mirror worlds.
36 | Every Crow carries Flame Elementium to control their mutated Hunters.
37 | The Infected will gradually lose themselves under the Aember's corrosion until they turn into monsters that are called Agitoes.
38 | A Hunter and their Crow partners are connected by a unique Pact that portrays their mutual choice and recognition.
39 | Because of the Pact between Hunters and Crows, their emotions and feelings are bound together.

43 | In the First Flame of the world, Six Gods were born.
44 | No one has ever seen the gods, but their footprints are found everywhere.
45 | According to legend, every waypoint you see today used to be a rivet nailed into the ground by gods during the Epoch of Might.

47 | For offending the dragons, dwarves were banished to the underground, so they would never be illuminated by the First Flame.
48 | The First Flame was originally located in Sol'Quinn until dwarves stole it and won the battle of Ragnarok.
49 | The Epoch of Hunting was a dark age when the world was shrouded in darkness like today.
50 | During the Epoch of War, kingdoms and heroes rose, and the civilizations developed rapidly.
51 | The conflicts during the Epoch of War last for thousands of years until a devastating flood put an end to everything.

55 | The Epoch of Knowledge was erased from history when all research results were burned by human hands.
56 | Humans rose to power in the Epoch of Deception.
57 | The emergence of Ember Tech opened the curtain of the Epoch of Machines

62 | Millions of years passed, and even the Behemoths fell. Their remains became Ember, yet the First Flames burned still.
63 | The First Flame was the legacy of the Creator and the seed that bred the new gods.
64 | The Clockwork Core opened the gates to different spacetimes, yet it invited ambitions and conflicts.

66 | Behemoths and the First Flame formed the original new world.
