text: Lava Form | While in [Lava Form], you ignite Nearby enemies, reducing their Fire Resistance. Ignite damage increases with your Fire energy bars. Enemy Fire Resistance is further reduced as the ignite Duration increases.

name: Crystal Form
text: Crystal Form | While in [Crystal Form], slow Nearby enemies, increasing their Cold Damage taken. The effects of slow and Cold Damage bonus increase with the Cold Energy bars.

name: Explosive
text: Explosive | Explosive units will leave 2 sparks within 3m upon death. When any unit approaches a spark, the spark explode in 0.5s, dealing the host's 3% Max Life as Fire Damage to Nearby units caught in the explosion. Sparks deal secondary damage. Sparks last for 5 second and explode when they expire.

name: Spark
text: Spark | Explosive units will leave 2 sparks within 3m upon death. When any unit approaches a spark, the spark explode in 0.5s, dealing the host's 3% Max Life as Fire Damage to Nearby units caught in the explosion. Sparks deal secondary damage. Sparks last for 5 second and explode when they expire.

name: Energy Gauge
text: Energy Gauge | You have two energy gauges, respectively for your Cold and Fire energy / Each gauge stores up to 3 bars of the corresponding energy / When you are holding Cold (Fire) energy, using a Fire (Cold) skill consumes all of your Cold (Fire) energy and will not grant Fire (Cold) energy as it does otherwise / When you haven't used any Cold (Fire) skill recently, the stored Cold (Fire) energy diminishes

name: Depletion
text: Depletion | After not casting Fire or Cold Skills, Fire and Cold Energy will deplete. The higher the bars, the shorter the depletion time.

name: Frostfire Rampage
text: Frostfire Rampage | +50% Fusion Energy effect for 5s during which Fusion Energy won't deplete. Loses all Fusion Energy when the Duration ends. Cooldown: 11s.

name: Rage
text: Rage | A Berserker exclusive energy that has a default upper limit of 100 / Upon reaching max Rage, Berserker enters Berserk

name: Berserk
text: Berserk | Gains bonuses twice the Max Rage while Berserk is active / Berserk expires when you run out of Rage

name: Burst
text: Burst | When triggered, deals powerful area explosion damage equal to 340% of Weapon Damage to enemies within 3m. While Dual Wielding, the Base Damage is the average damage of both weapons. / For every +1 to Skill Level, Burst +10% additional damage (multiplies) / Skill Tags: Attack, Melee, Physical, Triggered, Area, Strength, Dexterity

name: Cyclone
text: Cyclone | Creates a persistent cyclone that periodically deals damage to enemies within its range. The damage dealt and the ticking interval of the cyclone are based on your Base Damage and Attack Speed.

name: Special Ammo
text: Special Ammo | Adds a Support Skill to the bottom left corner of the Hero Trait menu. There is a chance to reload the special ammo of the added Support Skill. / The special ammo will be successfully consumed and effects of the added Support Skill will be granted if the added Support Skill is not on the skill panel and able to support Projectile Skills.

name: Explosive Rounds
text: Explosive Rounds | Explosive rounds grant +2 Projectiles but reduce the Projectile base range to 5m. Multiple Projectiles may hit the same target at once. Explosive rounds no longer have the base ammo effects and deal 20% less damage.

name: Speed Round
text: Speed Round | When firing Speed Rounds, +3% Attack Speed, Cast Speed, and Projectile Speed for 4s. The effect is stackable

name: Reload
text: Reload | Projectile Skills consume ammo. When you are out of ammo, you must reload to use these skills again.

name: Reload
text: Reload | Spends some time to fully reload the magazine. Unable to use Projectile Skills while reloading

name: Magic Shot
text: Magic Shot | While Magic Shot is active, each Projectile Skill used or triggered consumes 3 ammo. When multiple special ammo is consumed, Projectile Skills will gain corresponding effects of the Support Skills. As long as magic shot is on, reloading is instant.

name: Blank Firing
text: Blank Firing | Projectile Skills can be used without ammo. / No ammo benefits are applied when Blank Firing.

name: Auto Reload
text: Auto Reload | When no Projectile Skills have been used recently, the character will start reloading automatically. When a fixed quantity of ammo is auto-reloaded, it will complete instantly. Auto-reloading can be interrupted.

name: Spacetime Illusion
text: Spacetime Illusion | Spacetime Illusion can only use Spell Skills and cannot use any Channeled and Summon Skills. / Only 1 Spacetime Illusion may exist at a time. After reaching the summoning limit, click on the Trait Slot to call back the Spacetime Illusion

name: Overload
text: Overload | Provides buffs for your Minions / Bonuses that apply to Empower Skill Effects are also applied to Overload Effect / Bonuses that apply to Skill Effect Duration are also applied to Overload Duration

name: Multistrike Damage Increment
text: Multistrike Damage Increment | Attacks during Multistrike gain damage bonus based on the current Multistrike Count

name: Multistrike Count
text: Multistrike Count | Records the current attack's number of attacks during Multistrike when a Multistrike is triggered. The next attack's count during Multistrike +1 for each attack made

name: Frost Restoration
text: Frost Restoration | Regenerates 1.2% of Life per second / +10% Energy Shield Charge Speed.

name: Spacetime Turbulence
text: Spacetime Turbulence | Deals True Damage equal to the shared damage every second for 2s

name: Part of Skills
text: Part of Skills | Corrosive Throw's falloff ratio is 58%. Split Shot's falloff ratio is 33%.

name: Twisted Spacetime
text: Twisted Spacetime | Gives buffs to allies within range / Gains great buffs while inside Twisted Spacetime

name: Twisted Spacetime
text: Twisted Spacetime | Records the Damage Over Time you deal to enemies while Twisted Spacetime is active / After moving the Twisted Spacetime, enemies within its area will be inflicted with Spacetime Turbulence that deals True Damage

name: God's Boon
text: God's Boon | Consumes Focus Blessing to bestow God's Boon and gain Explosion for a short time.

name: Cat's Agility
text: Cat's Agility | +40% Movement Speed and +40% additional Attack Damage. / 240% of the increase/decrease on Movement Speed is also applied to Attack Damage.

name: Feline Figure
text: Feline Figure | Inflicts Numbed stacks equal to the number of Electrify stacks on enemies within the area / Skill Tags: Spell, Lightning

name: Seething Spirit
text: Seething Spirit | An ancestor spirit that casts your Non-Mobility and Non-Channeled Main Melee Attack Skills when it appears

name: Self-Destruct Protocol
text: Self-Destruct Protocol | Synthetic Troop Minions are immediately defeated 1s after activation. The base multiplier for Minions to self-destruct is 115%. / Skill Tags: Attack, Melee, Physical, Area, Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence

name: Volley
text: Volley | Fired Projectiles fly abrest

name: Secondary Skill
text: Secondary Skill | The second skill on the Skill Wheel (bottom left)

name: Shotgun Effect
text: Shotgun Effect | Multiple effects from the same skill can hit the same enemy. The first effect hit deals 100% damage, and subsequent effects hit deal less damage. This effect also applies to Ailment Damage dealt by skills. / Most skills' subsequent on hit damage is 36% / Special Skills' Shotgun Effect can be found in the Skill Stone's description.

name: Divine Realm
text: Divine Realm | Converts all Tenacity Blessings to Agility Blessings and deals additional damage to Full Life enemies when outside the Divine Realm / Converts all Agility Blessings to Tenacity Blessings and deals additional damage to Low Life enemies when within the Divine Realm

name: Stalker
text: Stalker | +13% additional damage during Multistrike for every stack of Stalker / Initial max stacks: 3. Lasts for 4s

name: Self-Destruct
text: Self-Destruct | Self-Destruct Damage

name: Additional Multistrike Damage Increment
text: Additional Multistrike Damage Increment | Gains additional bonuses for damage increased with each strike for this time's attack based on the current Multistrike Count

name: Landslide
text: Landslide | During Magic Shot, casting or triggering Projectile Skills consumes all ammo in the magazine. / +20% additional damage dealt by this Projectile Skill if 4 Special Ammo are consumed / +40% additional damage dealt by this Projectile Skill if 5 Special Ammo are consumed / +80% additional damage dealt by this Projectile Skill if 6 Special Ammo are consumed

name: Spacetime Speed-up
text: Spacetime Speed-up | Each enemy within Twisted Spacetime restores Youga's Spacetime Energy equal to 15% of the Affliction inflicted per second. / +2% additional Affliction effect for every 5 Spacetime Energy consumed within 10s, up to +40%

name: Cat Dive
text: Cat Dive | During Multistrike, for every +4% Movement Speed, there is a +1% chance for this attack to deal damage equal to the Max Multistrike Count / +1 Maximum Multistrike Count for every stack of Stalker

name: Last Stand
text: Last Stand | Minions won't be defeated when they have Overload / -100% Life Restoration Speed for Minions when they have Overload / Minions deal additional damage based on their Missing Life when they have Overload, up to +50%.

name: Desperate Measure
text: Desperate Measure | No longer reload ammo when using Mobility Skills. / -25% additional Damage. / Your Projectile Skills will consume all ammo / +35% damage for each ammo consumed (multiplies).

name: Rage Accumulation
text: Rage Accumulation | +50 Max Rage / When Seething Spirit uses a skill, you gain 9 additional Rage

name: Frozen Flame
text: Frozen Flame | At Max Fusion Energy, Fire Damage can inflict Frostbite, and Cold Damage can inflict Ignite / At Max Fusion Energy, Fire Damage increases 4 Frostbite Rating on hit / At Max Fusion Energy, Ignite inflicted by a Spell Skill gains 100% of the skill's Cold Damage as Base Ignite Damage. / At Max Fusion Energy, Ignite inflicted by an Attack Skill adds 100% of the weapon's Physical Damage and Cold Damage to the Base Ignite Damage

name: Heroic Sacrifice
text: Heroic Sacrifice | A 20% chance to drop a Mechanical Part for Synthetic Troop Minions when defeating an enemy or hitting an Elite. / +5% Overload Effect for every Mechanical Part recently picked up. / The Self-Destruct triggered by Self-Destruct Protocol deals +1% additional Damage for every +2% Overload Effect

name: Frenzy Furious
text: Frenzy Furious | +1% additional Critical Strike Rating for every 5 Rage you have / +1% additional Attack Damage on Critical Strike for every 5 Rage you have

name: Frost Heart
text: Frost Heart | +1% Frost Restoration Duration for every 1% Cold Resistance / +2 Max Frost Restoration Stacks

name: Holy Domain
text: Holy Domain | The Holy Domain automatically closes 1s after you leave the Holy Domain / The Holy Domain has a radius of 5m. Not affected by Skill Area bonuses

name: Seize Momentum
text: Seize Momentum | +30% Holy Domain radius / Ignores physical collisions when in the Holy Domain / For every attack Blocked while inside the Holy Domain, gains 1 stack of Brave Advance / For every 10m of movement made, gains 1 stack of Brave Advance / Brave Advance stacks up to 30 time(s)

name: Murderous Intent
text: Murderous Intent | The base upper limit of Murderous Intent is 100

name: Divine Realm Power
text: Divine Realm Power | -50% additional Blessing Duration / +5% additional damage for every stack of blessing consumed when the Divine Realm is active. Stacks up to 25 time(s)

name: Doomsday Fission
text: Doomsday Fission | Casts Empower Skill and gains Fission for 6s. Cooldown: 10s. / Upon losing Fission, no bombs can be thrown until the trait node is fully cooled down. / -20% Projectile Range.

name: Desperate Measure
text: Desperate Measure | No longer reload ammo when using Mobility Skills. / -25% additional Damage. / Your Projectile Skills will consume all ammo / +35% damage for each ammo consumed (multiplies).

name: Twisted Field
text: Twisted Field | While inside Twisted Spacetime, additionally increases Spell Damage dealt by your Spacetime Illusion by 18% per second. The effect stops stacking after 6 / The effect resets when you exit Twisted Spacetime for 0.5s.

name: Predicted Sacrifice
text: Predicted Sacrifice | If the Divine Punishment consumes all stacks of Focus Blessing, you will gain Tenacity and Agility Blessing of half of the stacks of Focus Blessing. / +40% additional damage if the Divine Punishment has consumed all stacks of Focus Blessing recently.

name: Run Away
text: Run Away | +2% additional Projectile Damage / +1% Movement Speed

name: Fission
text: Fission | Doubles the bombs thrown. / -10% additional Projectile Damage.

name: Uncontrolled Anger
text: Uncontrolled Anger | All Damage additionally +80% while Berserk is active / Berserk consumes 10% of Max Life per second / +60% Rage Cost while Berserk is active

name: Split Form
text: Split Form | No longer gain Rage when taking damage / Taking damage reduces Rage instead / Each point of Rage can only compensate for damage equal to 0.5% of the sum of Max Life and Max Energy Shield / All Max Resistances are fixed at 60% / +2% additional Max Life for every 15% Resistance exceeding the Max Resistance

name: Frost Embrace
text: Frost Embrace | +5 Max Frostbite Rating for enemies for each time they have been hit by Cold Pulse recently. Cooldown: 0.1s / When Cold Pulse hits an enemy recently, +1% Cold Pulse Cooldown Recovery Speed for every 6 points of Frostbite Rating the enemy has. Interval: 0.2s.

name: Death by Fire
text: Death by Fire | Deals True Damage equal to the damage recorded by Brand to all enemies in an area. / The initial radius of Death by Fire is 5m. After Death by Fire is triggered, all damage recorded by Brand is removed

name: Full Bloom
text: Full Bloom | Spirit Magi grow into their ultimate form, which unlocks their Ultimate that has an initial cooldown of 8s. / 50% of the Attack Speed bonus and additional bonus to Spirit Magi is also applied to additional Spirit Magi Attack Damage. / 50% of the Cast Speed bonus and additional bonus to Spirit Magi is also applied to additional Spirit Magi Spell Damage.

name: Windrider
text: Windrider | A Spell Channeled Skill with a base channel interval of 0.33s and can be channeled up to 5 stack(s). / At max channeled stacks, loses all channeled stacks and grants 3 stack(s) of Nourishment to Spirit Magi within 12m

name: Darkness Interval
text: Darkness Interval | Shotgun Effect's subsequent Projectiles +2%

name: Nourishment
text: Nourishment | When using a skill, +30% additional damage for that use. Lasts 15s and stacks up to 10 time(s). Effect of Nourishment enjoys Empower Skill Effect bonuses.

name: Purgatory
text: Purgatory | Additionally increases the damage taken by enemies within the area of Purgatory

name: Brand
text: Brand | Deals additional damage to Branded enemies / Records the damage enemies receive, then deals True Damage to enemies according to the recorded damage when inflicting Death by Fire

name: Amazing Friends
text: Amazing Friends | -1 Max Spirit Magus Quantity / After gaining a total of 20 stack(s) of Nourishment, Spirit Magi enter Full Bloom for 12s / For every 10 Growth a Spirit Magus has, it +2% additional Full Bloom Duration

name: Scorching Trampling
text: Scorching Trampling | -20% Brand-recorded damage that Death by Fire removes / For every +1 Fire Skill Level, -4% Brand-recorded damage that Death by Fire removes, up to -40% / Brand disappears after Death by Fire is triggered 4 time(s)

name: Heat Up
text: Heat Up | Additionally increases Projectiles Damage based on Heat Up stacks and increases the Projectile Max Deviation Angle

name: Overheated
text: Overheated | Forced to reload after being in Overheated for a period of time

name: Projectile Max Deviation Angle
text: Projectile Max Deviation Angle | Horizontal and Parabolic Projectiles will deviate from the shooting direction, and the max deviation angle is determined by the Projectile Max Deviation Angle / Within 0.5s after stopping shooting, the Deviation Angle returns to normal within 2s

name: Brave Advance
text: Brave Advance | +1% Physique, +1% Movement Speed, +1% additional damage taken and +3% damage to enemies in the Holy Domain. Lasts 8s, affected by Skill Effect Duration bonuses.

name: Burning Red
text: Burning Red | Burning Red lasts for 10s. No longer gains Overheated or reloads while this is active / Gains 100% Heat Up effect bonuses but cannot trigger Empower, Curse, or Warcry skills. / Forced to reload after this effect ends

name: Projectile Size
text: Projectile Size | Changes Projectile Size / In general, 100% of Projectile Size is applied to the size of Projectiles / For Projectiles affected by Skill Area Bonuses, 25% of the increase or decrease in Projectile Size is applied to the additional Skill Area of Projectiles / For Projectiles that have subsequent Area Effects, 25% of the increase or decrease in Projectile Size is also applied to the additional Skill Area of the subsequent effects / Subsequent effects: Effects caused by Projectile after they are fired, such as explosions

name: Block Ratio Upper Limit
text: Block Ratio Upper Limit | The Block Ratio's upper limit is 60% by default and can be increased to a maximum of 80%

name: Holy Illumination
text: Holy Illumination | When this is cast, consumes 5 Murderous Intent and forcefully drags all non-boss enemies in the area into the Holy Domain. Cooldown: 0.6s / Holy Illumination's radius: 8m. Not affected by Skill Area bonuses

name: Desperation
text: Desperation | For every 5 Murderous Intent you currently have, +1% additional Attack and Cast Speed for all units in the Holy Domain / For every 5 Murderous Intent you currently have, +2% additional damage to enemies in the Holy Domain

name: Arctic
text: Arctic | Deals 12% additional damage to an enemy for every 1 stack(s) of Arctic the enemy has

name: Blooming Frost Flower
text: Blooming Frost Flower | Upon inflicting Freeze, casts Cold Pulse at the Frozen target once without consuming any Cold Energy / Enemies +12% additional Cold Damage taken for every Cold Pulse hit they took recently. Lasts for 4s. Stacks up to 5 time(s)

name: Electrify
text: Electrify | For every stack of Electrify, Feline Figure inflicts 1 stack of Numbed on enemies within the area

name: Lightning Fast
text: Lightning Fast | No longer triggers Feline Figure on hit / When having Shock, 30% chance to trigger Feline Figure on up to 3 enemies for every 1m of movement made. Cooldown: 0.4s / Every time Feline Figure settles Shock Damage on an enemy, the enemy +5% additional Hit Damage taken from the character next time, up to +200% additional damage

name: Own Base Shock Damage
text: Own Base Shock Damage | Own Base Shock Damage: / The character's own Base Shock Damage calculates the sum of Base Shock Damage added. For example: Adds 1 Base Shock Damage. / However, it doesn't calculate the Base Shock Damage obtained. For example: Gains 3% of Lightning Damage as Base Shock Damage on hit.

name: Boiling Anger
text: Boiling Anger | For every 8 Rage, Seething Spirit +1% additional damage. / This bonus increases by 50% while standing still.

name: Annihilator Mode
text: Annihilator Mode | +20% additional Attack and Cast Speed / The Projectile Quantity and Splits of Projectile Skills are only affected by the skill itself and linked Support Skills

name: Mobile Mode
text: Mobile Mode | +20% Movement Speed / Standard Projectile mode, where the Projectile Quantity and Splits of Projectile Skills receive bonuses normally

name: Knocks Back Yourself
text: Knocks Back Yourself | The base Knockback Distance is 1m / 80% of the Knockback Distance bonus is also applied to the Knockback Distance against you, up to +200%

name: Endless Frenzy
text: Endless Frenzy | For every +2% Knockback Distance, +1% additional damage, up to +200% / During Mobile Mode, you are guaranteed to Knock Back Yourself when casting a non-Channeled or non-Mobility Projectile Skill / During Annihilator Mode, Heat Up gains an additional effect: +2% Knockback Distance

name: No Guard
text: No Guard | +10% additional damage taken / Channeled stacks lost increase the effect of No Guard, with the first 2 stacks lost increasing its effect by 100%, and each additional stack lost further increasing its effect by 100%

name: Hunting Instinct
text: Hunting Instinct | +1 to Initial Multistrike Count and Max Multistrike Count. +15% additional Attack Damage to attacks that reach max Multistrike Count. Lasts for 30s. Unable to gain Interest during Hunting Instinct

name: Stun
text: Stun | Cannot act

name: Weaken
text: Weaken | Additionally reduces damage dealt by 10%

name: Blind
text: Blind | Target's damage has a 20% chance to miss before addressed

name: Knockback
text: Knockback | Forced to move back by a short distance

name: Paralysis
text: Paralysis | Increases damage taken by 15%

name: Slow
text: Slow | Each stack reduces Attack Speed, Cast Speed, and Movement Speed by 6%. Stacks up to 5 times

name: Freeze
text: Freeze | When a unit's Frostbite Rating exceeds 100, it becomes Frozen / Frozen non-Legendary bosses will be Frost-Sealed periodically and cannot act. The Frost-Seal duration is 1s, and the Frost-Seal Interval is 3 for the same unit / Frost-Seal ends when Frostbite ends

name: Thaw
text: Thaw | Recovering from the Frostbite status and returning to normal speed

name: Wilt
text: Wilt | An Ailment that may be triggered on hit, dealing Erosion Damage per second for 1.5s based on Base Wilt Damage. Stacks up to 30 time(s) / Wilt cannot be inflicted when Base Wilt Damage is 0

name: Ignite
text: Ignite | An Ailment that may be triggered on hit, dealing Fire Damage per second for 4s based on Base Ignite Damage. Unable to stack / Ignite cannot be inflicted when Base Ignite Damage is 0

name: Trauma
text: Trauma | An Ailment that may be triggered on hit, dealing Physical Damage per second for 4s based on Base Trauma Damage. Unable to stack / Trauma cannot be inflicted when Base Trauma Damage is 0

name: Shock
text: Shock | The Shock status is an Ailment that could be triggered when Lightning Damage hits its target. It's affected by Shock Chance. / Shock Damage is settled one additional time every time enemies in the Shock status are hit. / Shock Damage is Secondary Lightning Damage. It is not affected by bonuses and ignores Resistance. / Each Shock status can be settled up to 12 time(s). / Shock cannot be inflicted when Base Shock Damage is 0.

name: Taunt
text: Taunt | Forced to attack the taunting unit

name: Silence
text: Silence | Cannot cast Spells and warcries

name: Disarm
text: Disarm | Deemed to be unarmed and unable to use Attack Skills when disarmed. You are not deemed to be Dual Wielding or holding a Shield when disarmed.

name: Agility Blessing
text: Agility Blessing | Every stack of Agility Blessing grants +4% Attack and Cast Speed and +2% additional damage. Initial max stacks: 4

name: Surge
text: Surge | Increases Mana Restoration Speed and deals additional Spell Damage based on the effect level

name: Mark
text: Mark | The target is locked on. -20% Evasion and +10% additional Critical Strike Damage taken

name: Tenacity Blessing
text: Tenacity Blessing | Every stack of Tenacity Blessing grants an additional 4% damage reduction (multiplies). Initial max stacks: 4.

name: Barrier
text: Barrier | Gains a Shield equal to 20% of the sum of Max Life and Max Energy Shield, absorbing 50% of the Hit Damage taken. Cannot gain another Barrier when a Barrier is present.

name: Blur
text: Blur | Gains 100 points of Blur Rating / 10 Blur Rating is lost per second. Blur is lost once Blur Rating drops to 0 / +0.25% Chance to Avoid Damage for every point of Blur Rating you have / Max Blur Rating is 100

name: Root
text: Root | Cannot move (including walking, sprinting, blinking, and knockback)

name: Elapse
text: Elapse | +4% Damage Over Time taken by the target. Stacks up to 10 times

name: Rejuvenation
text: Rejuvenation | Restores 2% Max Life and Mana. Multiple (Rejuvenation) effects are calculated independently. Stacks up to 5 times

name: Frost-Seal
text: Frost-Seal | Frozen units non-Legendary bosses will be Frost-Sealed periodically and cannot act. The Frost-Sealed duration is 2s, and the Frost-Sealed Interval is 3 for the same unit

name: Life Regain
text: Life Regain | Based on the Missing Life (including Sealed Life), restores a portion of Life on hit. This effect has a 0.5s interval.

name: Shield regain
text: Shield regain | Based on the Missing Energy Shield, restores a portion of Energy Shield on hit. This effect may only appear once every 0.5s.

name: Frostbite
text: Frostbite | Frostbite is an Ailment that may be triggered on Cold Damage hits. Frostbitten enemies -10% Attack, Cast, and Movement Speed. Base Frostbite Rating: 10. For every 1 Frostbite Rating, +1% additional Cold Damage taken. The enemy will be Frozen once they have more than 100 Frostbite Rating.

name: Frostbite
text: Frostbite | Enemies are inflicted with a fixed amount of Frostbite Rating when they are Frostbitten. This can be increased by raising Max Frostbite Rating. The Max Frostbite Rating is 120.

name: Focus Blessing
text: Focus Blessing | Every stack of Focus Blessing grants +5% additional damage. Initial max stacks: 4

name: Knockback direction is reversed
text: Knockback direction is reversed | Inverts the Knockback direction

name: Fighting Will
text: Fighting Will | Accumulates Fervor Rating when you defeat enemies or hit Elite enemies while having Fervor. +2% Critical Strike Rating for every point of Fervor Rating. The Max Fervor Rating is 100 points.

name: Fervor rating
text: Fervor rating | +2% Critical Strike Rating for every point of Fervor Rating you have. The Max Fervor Rating is 100.

name: Blur Rating
text: Blur Rating | +0.25% chance to avoid damage for every point of Blur Rating you have. The Max Blur Rating is 100

name: Crowd Control Effects
text: Crowd Control Effects | Frostbite, Freeze, Paralysis, Knockback, Weaken, Slow, Taunt, and Blinding

name: Origin of Spirit Magus
text: Origin of Spirit Magus | Buff effect gained after Activating a Spirit Magus summoning skill.

name: Hardened
text: Hardened | -25% additional damage taken for 4s.

name: Origin of Fire
text: Origin of Fire | Increases Attack and Spell Critical Strike Rating.

name: Origin of Thunder
text: Origin of Thunder | Increases Attack and Cast Speed.

name: Contact Target
text: Contact Target | When a Parabolic Projectile lands or hits an enemy.

name: Wind Blade
text: Wind Blade | Wind Blade counts as a Steep Strike. It passes through all enemies and deals damage to them.

name: Command
text: Command | Equipping a skill that can summon Synthetic Troops will grant Command. Every point of Command will grant Synthetic Troop Minions +3% additional damage (+0% when Command is lower than 0), +-2% additional damage taken, ++2% Movement Speed, and a bigger Tracking Area. The lowest Command is -100 while the highest is 100. When Command is not 0, 13 points will be returned (reduced/granted) per second. For every 10 Command increased, +7 additional points returned until the total Command becomes 0.

name: Command
text: Command | Every point of Command will grant Synthetic Troop Minions +3% additional damage, +-2% additional damage taken, ++2% Movement Speed, and a bigger Tracking Area. / The lowest Command is -100 while the highest is 100. When Command is not 0, 13 point(s) will be returned (reduced/granted) every second until it becomes 0. For every 10 Command increased, +7 additional points will be returned. / Synthetic Troop Minions' Duration will not reduce when Command is a positive value.

name: Six Gods' Blessings
text: Six Gods' Blessings | Tenacity Blessing, Agility Blessing, Focus Blessing, Fervor, Blur, Barrier.

name: The new god is balancing Order and Chaos
text: The new god is balancing Order and Chaos | Character affected by the Order and Chaos: Initially has 100 points of Order and loses 1 point of Order per 1s. Gains 1 point of Chaos for every point of Order lost.

name: Order
text: Order | The character initially has 100 points of Order and loses 1 point per 1s. Gains 1 point of Chaos for every point of Order lost.

name: Chaos
text: Chaos | The character initially has 100 points of Order and loses 1 point per 1s. Gains 1 point of Chaos for every point of Order lost.

name: The new god is devouring Six Gods' blessings
text: The new god is devouring Six Gods' blessings | All Six Gods' Blessings the character has, including Tenacity Blessing, Agility Blessing, Focus Blessing, Fervor, Blur, and Barrier, will be devoured every 4s

name: Spell Burst
text: Spell Burst | Automatically uses a Spell Skill a certain number of times. / When Spell Burst is fully charged, the next Spell Skill used will activate Spell Burst, which will consume all stacks charged and automatically use the Spell Skill the same number of times. / Skills that have a cooldown, Triggered Skills, Sentry Skills, Channeled Skills, and Combo Skills cannot activate Spell Burst.

name: Devour
text: Devour | Nullifies Talents.

name: Replicate
text: Replicate | Additionally gains a copied Talent. When copying a devoured Talent, the duplicate Talent will become take effect normally. You can only copy the original Talents on the Divinity Slate and cannot copy Talents obtained via other replication effects.

name: Growth
text: Growth | Spirit Magi grow into the next Stage for every 100 Growth. They start at Stage 1 and can grow until they reach Stage 5. For every 8 Growth they have, Spirit Magi gain +1% Physique, +10% additional Skill Area, and a bonus every stage: / At Stage 2, +30% chance for them to use Enhanced Skill chance. / At Stage 3, their Enhanced Skills become stronger. / At Stage 4, their Empower Skills become stronger. / At Stage 5, they +50% additional damage, +10% additional Skill Area, and gain increased Movement Speed and Tracking Area. / The max Growth is 1000.

name: Notoriety
text: Notoriety | +2000 Critical Strike Rating, +100% Critical Strike Damage, and 20% Attack and Cast Speed for each stack of Notoriety. The Critical Strike Rating and Critical Strike Damage bonus granted by the skill is doubled against Low-Life enemies. This status is an Aura Status and is affected by Aura Effects

name: Renown
text: Renown | For each stack of Renown, +20 Attack Critical Strike Rating, +24% Critical Strike Damage, and +7% additional damage. Stacks up to 3 time(s). This status is an Aura Status and is affected by Aura Effects.

name: Numbed
text: Numbed | An Elemental Ailment that has a chance to be inflicted when Lightning Damage hits its target. / When hitting a Numbed enemy, Lightning Damage inflicts 1 stack of Numbed for every 10% of the sum of Max Energy Shield and Life dealt by Lightning Damage. This threshold can be lowered or raised, but the minimum is 1%. / The default duration of Numbed is 2s, and the duration of each stack is calculated independently. / Max Numbed stacks: 10. text: Ruins | May appear at a random location in Mistville. The four Cells around it will not be explorable.

name: Alchemy Workshop
text: Alchemy Workshop | May appear at a random location in Mistville. You can spend Coins to upgrade Old Stuff here.

name: Clock Tower
text: Clock Tower | May appear at a random location in Mistville. You can enter a battle here and start the day new.

name: Blank Stele
text: Blank Stele | A Bad Omen Stele with no special effects.

name: Bad Omen Stele - Blindness
text: Bad Omen Stele - Blindness | Bad Omen Steles with the following special effect: When this stele is present, it seals off 8 nearby unrevealed Cells

name: Bad Omen Stele - Anxiety
text: Bad Omen Stele - Anxiety | Bad Omen Steles with the following special effect: The Sanity cost for removing this stele is doubled

name: Bad Omen Stele - Poverty
text: Bad Omen Stele - Poverty | Bad Omen Steles with the following special effect: When this stele is present, you lose 10% of your current Coins for each Cell revealed

name: Bad Omen Stele - Anorexia
text: Bad Omen Stele - Anorexia | Bad Omen Steles with the following special effect: When this stele is present, you cannot consume Food

name: First Bank's Shackles
text: First Bank's Shackles | Old Stuff: You cannot gain any more Coins.

name: Rusty Cranial Nail
text: Rusty Cranial Nail | Old Stuff: You cannot restore any more Sanity.

name: Amnesia Patient's Key
text: Amnesia Patient's Key | Old Stuff: You cannot gain any more Old Stuff.

name: Brain in a Jar
text: Brain in a Jar | Old Stuff: Your Sanity cannot drop to 0. This Old Stuff will disappear when a new day begins.

name: Mistosis
text: Mistosis | Each stack of Mistosis grants 20% increased Chest of Folklores Drop Quantity. (You can only have up to 6 stacks of Mistosis.)

name: Bad Omen Stele
text: Bad Omen Stele | May appear at a random location in Mistville. Seals off nearby Cells. Can be removed at the cost of Sanity.

name: Torn Map
text: Torn Map | Old Stuff: Preview the location of 1 random Cell when a new day begins / Upgraded: Preview the location of the Clock Tower when a new day begins

name: Luxurious Golden Sauce
text: Luxurious Golden Sauce | Food: Quantity of another Food +3

name: Spoiled Sauce
text: Spoiled Sauce | Old Stuff: Every time you consume Food, there is a 30% chance that the Food's quantity will not be reduced

name: Resident's Old Bowl
text: Resident's Old Bowl | Old Stuff: 50% chance to obtain 1 Food when a new day begins

name: Resident's Wooden Box
text: Resident's Wooden Box | Old Stuff: 15% chance to obtain 1 Old Stuff when a new day begins

name: "Diviner"
text: "Diviner" | Old Stuff: You can preview the locations of all Bad Omen Steles

name: "Banker"
text: "Banker" | Old Stuff: Obtain 80 Coins when a new day begins

name: "Cartographer"
text: "Cartographer" | Old Stuff: Preview 5 random Cells when a new day begins

name: "Explorer"
text: "Explorer" | Old Stuff: Reveal 5 random Cells when a new day begins

name: Egg of the Deep Mist
text: Egg of the Deep Mist | Old Stuff: The Sanity cost of removing a Bad Omen Stele -25 / The Sanity cost of removing a Bad Omen Stele +5 when a new day begins

name: Egg of the Shallow Mist
text: Egg of the Shallow Mist | Old Stuff: The Sanity cost of exploring a Cell -5 / The Sanity cost of exploring a Cell +1 when a new day begins

name: White Crow Bonsai
text: White Crow Bonsai | Old Stuff: The Sanity cost of removing a Bad Omen Stele +10 / The Sanity cost of removing a Bad Omen Stele -4 when a new day begins

name: Black Crow Bonsai
text: Black Crow Bonsai | Old Stuff: The Sanity cost of exploring a Cell +4 / The Sanity cost of exploring a Cell -2 when a new day begins

name: Chest of Folklores
text: Chest of Folklores | Reward obtained by completing the Advent of Folklores after reaching the Clock Tower

name: Fine Activation Medium Skills
text: Fine Activation Medium Skills | Activation Medium: Preparation, Activation Medium: Elite, and Activation Medium: Severe Injury

name: Precious Activation Medium Skills
text: Precious Activation Medium Skills | Activation Medium: Motionless, Activation Medium: Preparation, Activation Medium: Elite, Activation Medium: Boss, Activation Medium: Life, Activation Medium: Energy Shield, Activation Medium: Severe Injury, Activation Medium: Multistrike, Activation Medium: Demolisher, Activation Medium: Spell Burst, Activation Medium: Start, Activation Medium: Root, Activation Medium: Resonance Activation, Activation Medium: Resonance

name: Matchless Activation Medium Skills
text: Matchless Activation Medium Skills | Activation Medium: Rhythm, Activation Medium: Root Attack, Activation Medium: Sentry, Activation Medium: Minion, Activation Medium: Critical Strike, Activation Medium: Channel, Activation Medium: Instruction, Activation Medium: Lock On, Activation Medium: Track

name: Ultimate Activation Medium Skills
text: Ultimate Activation Medium Skills | Activation Medium: Perpetual Motion, Activation Medium: Wind Rhythm, Activation Medium: Still Attack, Activation Medium: Burst Activation, Activation Medium: Tangle

name: Cogwheel
text: Cogwheel | A mechanism that appears in the stage after Clockwork Ballet Games begin. Activate it and eliminate nearby monsters to obtain a Cogwheel Voucher of the same rarity and type.

name: Operation Cogwheel
text: Operation Cogwheel | Activating a Cogwheel and eliminating all the monsters nearby to complete Operation Cogwheel once. Upon doing so, you will usually get Cogwheel Vouchers of the same rarity as the Cogwheel.

name: Cogwheel Voucher
text: Cogwheel Voucher | Complete Operation Cogwheel or specific challenges in stages to get Cogwheel Vouchers. When Clockwork Ballet Games end, Cogwheel Vouchers can be exchanged for rewards of corresponding types and rarities.

name: Rating
text: Rating | Your rating in the game increases as you defeat Doll Employees or obtain Cogwheel Vouchers. There are 9 rating tiers, ranging from F to SSS, and the Cogwheel Vouchers obtained during the game will be exchanged for base rewards at the end. The higher your Challenge Rating, the higher the multiplier on those rewards.

name: Booster Drink
text: Booster Drink | An item that appears in Clockwork Ballet Games. Touching it increases your Movement Speed for a period of time.

name: Time Extender
text: Time Extender | An item that appears in Clockwork Ballet Games. Touching it increases the remaining time of the current game.

name: Runaway Dancer
text: Runaway Dancer | A Clockwork Ballet Doll Employee that is as strong as a Rare monster.

name: Low-Level Doll Employee
text: Low-Level Doll Employee | A Clockwork Ballet Doll Employee that is as strong as a Normal monster.

name: Bloody Mary
text: Bloody Mary | A Clockwork Ballet Doll Employee that is as strong as a Boss monster.

name: Clockwork Carnival
text: Clockwork Carnival | Go to the Clockwork Carnival to challenge the season endgame gameplay of Clockwork Ballet Games. You'll enter a map filled with Cogwheels, where your goal is to collect as many Cogwheel Vouchers as possible within the time limit and exchange them for fantastic rewards. Additional time can't be gained in this stage, and the rating can only be improved by completing Operation Cogwheel.

name: Outstanding Doll Employee
text: Outstanding Doll Employee | A Clockwork Ballet Doll Employee that is as strong as a Rare monster.

name: Iron Curtain of Eminence
text: Iron Curtain of Eminence | Go to Iron Curtain of Eminence to challenge Clockwork Ballet President - Silverwing Danseuse, the supreme boss of the Clockwork Ballet Season.

name: Gold Member Services
text: Gold Member Services | In order of rarity, the Member Services that are selectable before Clockwork Ballet Games begin are Bronze Member Services, Amethyst Member Services, Gold Member Services, and Diamond Member Services.

name: Diamond Member Services
text: Diamond Member Services | In order of rarity, the Member Services that are selectable before Clockwork Ballet Games begin are Bronze Member Services, Amethyst Member Services, Gold Member Services, and Diamond Member Services.

name: Blowout Sale
text: Blowout Sale | Before you start Clockwork Ballet Games, there's a chance that a portal to the Clockwork Carnival will appear, allowing you to go to the season endgame gameplay.

name: Clockwork Ball Ticket
text: Clockwork Ball Ticket | Before you start Clockwork Ballet Games, there's a chance that a portal to Iron Curtain of Eminence will appear, allowing you to challenge the supreme boss Clockwork Ballet President - Silverwing Danseuse.

name: Member Services
text: Member Services | Before Clockwork Ballet Games begin, you can select one of three effects. Completing the corresponding challenge will earn you a reward. In order of rarity, Member Services include Bronze Member Services, Amethyst Member Services, Gold Member Services, and Diamond Member Services.

name: All Tabs on Me
text: All Tabs on Me | 1-2 Rainbow Cogwheels will appear in the stage. Cogwheel Vouchers can't be exchanged for rewards until Operation Cogwheel is fully completed.

name: Dolls' Hunting Ground
text: Dolls' Hunting Ground | When starting Operation Cogwheel, time gained is doubled, and there's a 50% chance to obtain 1 additional Cogwheel Voucher that is more likely to be a higher rarity voucher. This game will end immediately when you are defeated. The default time is 20s, and the default rating is C

name: Clockwork Roulette
text: Clockwork Roulette | Every time you obtain a Cogwheel Voucher, you also obtain 1 additional Cogwheel Voucher of a random rarity, and +1 to the number of Cogwheel Vouchers you obtain next time. +9% chance for you to immediately lose the challenge when starting Operation Cogwheel. When you are defeated, you will lose all Cogwheel Vouchers and this Member Service will immediately expire

name: Roses in the No-Man's Land
text: Roses in the No-Man's Land | All monsters in the stage are replaced with Low-Level Doll Employees. There are only 7 Rainbow Cogwheels in this stage

name: Bloody Mary
text: Bloody Mary | After Clockwork Ballet Games begin, immediately obtain 3-5 Cogwheel Vouchers (Purple or above). Failure to submit Cogwheel Vouchers will cause you to lose the challenge and make you unable to exchange rewards. Increase the default rating to SS with a default time of 15s, but Bloody Mary starts chasing you after 3s

name: Clockwork Heist
text: Clockwork Heist | When completing the last Operation Cogwheel in the stage, 3 Runaway Dancers will appear. You obtain 1 Cogwheel Voucher of a random rarity (up to Red) for each Runaway Dancer defeated

name: Free Refill Day
text: Free Refill Day | 1 new Cogwheel will be respawned nearby every time you obtain a Cogwheel Voucher. The default time is 75s, and no more time can be gained. The default Cogwheel quantity is 1

name: Nut Trick
text: Nut Trick | Upon obtaining 3 Cogwheel Vouchers of the same rarity in a row, change the rarity of these 3 Cogwheel Vouchers to Rainbow

name: Blowout Sale
text: Blowout Sale | Time gained additionally -20%. A Portal to Clockwork Carnival will be opened after fully completing Operation Cogwheel and ending the gameplay

name: Clockwork Ball Ticket
text: Clockwork Ball Ticket | When starting Operation Cogwheel, 2 additional Outstanding Doll Employees will appear. A Portal to Iron Curtain of Eminence will be opened after fully completing Operation Cogwheel and ending the gameplay

name: Member Privilege
text: Member Privilege | After Clockwork Ballet Games begin, Cogwheels that appear in the stage have a chance to carry reward effects.

name: Reverse Pocket Watch
text: Reverse Pocket Watch | During the event, defeating monsters have a chance to drop this item. Collect a certain number of them to exchange them for great rewards in the Behind the Stage event

name: Clockwork Ballet Podium
text: Clockwork Ballet Podium | A podium that appears at the end of Clockwork Ballet Games. Interact with this to put Cogwheel Vouchers into it, end the gameplay, and exchange rewards

name: Cogwheel Thief
text: Cogwheel Thief | Drops Orange or better Cogwheel Vouchers when defeated

name: Doll Security
text: Doll Security | Doll monsters that appear randomly after Clockwork Ballet Games begin. When a Cogwheel is activated, Doll Securities will not be refreshed.

name: Rusted Abyss Quest
text: Rusted Abyss Quest | Complete the story quests of Chapter 3

name: Moderate Symptom
text: Moderate Symptom | Increases Vorax monsters' Life and Attack. / Only takes effect once even if multiple Moderate symptoms are present. When both Moderate and Severe symptoms are present, only the Severe symptoms take effect.

name: Severe Symptom
text: Severe Symptom | Significantly increases Vorax monsters' Life and Attack. / Only takes effect once even if multiple Severe symptoms are present. When both Moderate and Severe symptoms are present, only the Severe symptoms take effect.

name: Colored Snow
text: Colored Snow | Used to upgrade nodes in Artistry of the Frozen Canvas gameplay

name: Splendor Egg
text: Splendor Egg | Complete Cell challenges in the Frozen Canvas to get rewards. The higher the Color Level of Splendor Eggs, the better the drops. / Splendor Egg drops are only affected by the Splendor Egg Drop Quantity bonus and the Drop Quantity bonus of the corresponding Snowpaper difficulty

name: Max Possible Level
text: Max Possible Level | Expands the Snowpaper and the max possible level of dropped Paints while painting

name: Forced Color Mixing
text: Forced Color Mixing | Automatically completes the current Color Mixing Objective but applies debuffs. The more times Forced Color Mixing is used in a game, the more severe the debuffs.

name: Spread
text: Spread | Makes it possible to apply Coloring Paints to Blocked Cells, Void Cells, or Discolored Cells to expand the Frozen Canvas map.

name: Fateful Contest
text: Fateful Contest | The Arcana Season's endgame gameplay can be challenged after completing the Tarot Path

name: Start Over
text: Start Over | Removes all the Paints that have been put in and start over

name: Chest of Destiny
text: Chest of Destiny | A treasure chest containing rewards obtained from the Arcana gameplay. The higher the Color Level of Chests of Destiny, the better the drops

name: Tarot Path
text: Tarot Path | Complete the Tarot Trials a certain number of times in Netherrealm stages to enter the Tarot Path and collect Chests of Destiny.

name: Notes of Arcana
text: Notes of Arcana | There is a chance for Notes of Arcana to drop when completing Tarot Trials in Netherrealm stages. Notes of Arcana can be used in the Tarot Path. From least to most rare, the rarity levels of Notes of Arcana are: Bad, Good, Favorable, and Auspicious.

name: Destiny Slot
text: Destiny Slot | Does not use Destiny Install Qualifications

name: Quicksand Treasure Stash
text: Quicksand Treasure Stash | A special Treasure Stash with greater rewards and guaranteed battles

name: Level
text: Level | The base productivity of laborers increases with their level. / From Lv. 5 onwards, laborers will start to gain random affixes.

name: Higher Level
text: Higher Level | The Laborer Level might exceed the unlocked max level (the upper limit cannot be exceeded)

name: Laborer
text: Laborer | In Netherrealm stages, there is a chance to recruit defeated Sand Pirates as laborers. / The productivity and wage cost of laborers increase with their level.

name: Production Line
text: Production Line | In each production line, you can select 1 resource and assign up to 3 laborers to produce this resource. / Each building can have up to 4 production lines.

name: Island Reputation Level
text: Island Reputation Level | By trading with Floating Islands, you can earn Reputation with them. As your Reputation grows, your Island Reputation Level increases. / The higher your Reputation Level, the more items you can bring back from trading. Each Island Reputation Level unlocks different items that can be brought back.

name: Island Reputation Level 3
text: Island Reputation Level 3 |

name: Island Reputation Level 4
text: Island Reputation Level 4 |

name: Island Reputation Level 5
text: Island Reputation Level 5 |

name: Island Reputation Level 6
text: Island Reputation Level 6 |

name: Island Reputation Level 7
text: Island Reputation Level 7 |

name: Island Reputation Level 8
text: Island Reputation Level 8 |

name: Miner
text: Miner | A laborer who can produce Ingots in the Mine.

name: Crystal Worker
text: Crystal Worker | A laborer who can produce Magic Crystals in the Mine.

name: Chef
text: Chef | A laborer who produces food at the Logistics Department.

name: Aviator
text: Aviator | A laborer who engages in trades at the Port.

name: Mercenary
text: Mercenary | A laborer who goes on raids at the Port.

name: Extra Drop Goblin
text: Extra Drop Goblin | An Extra Drop Goblin is a special boss monster that can drop lots of items when defeated.

name: Legendary Goblin
text: Legendary Goblin | A Legendary Goblin is a special boss monster that can drop lots of Legendary gear when defeated.

name: Ember Goblin
text: Ember Goblin | An Ember Goblin is a special boss monster that can drop Ultimate Ember when defeated.

name: Fluorescent Goblin
text: Fluorescent Goblin | A Fluorescent Goblin is a special boss monster that can drop lots of Fluorescent Memories when defeated.

name: Compass Goblin
text: Compass Goblin | A Compass Goblin is a special boss monster that can drop lots of Compasses when defeated.

name: Beacon Goblin
text: Beacon Goblin | A Beacon Goblin is a special boss monster that can drop lots of Beacons when defeated.

name: Crafty Goblin
text: Crafty Goblin | A Crafty Goblin is a special boss monster that can drop lots of gear when defeated.

name: Carjack
text: Carjack | After activating the Transport Vehicle in the Netherrealm stage, the escort bodyguards will attempt to flee with the payload. Chase after them and defeat incoming reinforcements to earn corresponding rewards

name: TOWER Co. Central Vault
text: TOWER Co. Central Vault | Go to TOWER Co. Central Vault to challenge the endgame gameplay of the Outlaw season. You will enter a map with many small strongrooms. With each small strongroom you raid, security becomes tighter and tighter until you fail to raid a strongroom within the time limit and find yourself up against the boss. Defeat the boss to loot the bountiful rewards of the ultimate strongroom.

name: Bounty Order
text: Bounty Order | Before the Carjack starts, you have a chance to receive a Bounty Order from the Black Market. Reveal the Bounty Order by inserting TOWER Coins, and complete it to get additional Bounty Chests. There are three Bounty Order qualities: Basic, Generous, and Astronomical.

name: Plane Watcher Chest
text: Plane Watcher Chest | Includes Netherrealm Resonance and Ecliptic Astrolabe. Not affected by Drop Quantity bonuses, but are affected by Netherrealm Timemark

name: Traveler Chest
text: Traveler Chest | Includes Netherrealm Resonance and Ecliptic Astrolabe. Not affected by Drop Quantity bonuses, but are affected by Netherrealm Timemark

name: Gods Chest
text: Gods Chest | Includes items such as Divinity Emblems, Astrolabes, and Netherrealm Resonances. Not affected by Drop Quantity bonuses, but are affected by Netherrealm Timemark

name: Divine Rite
text: Divine Rite | Complete the Gods gameplay to obtain stacks. Spawns an additional Gods Chest in the boss area when reaching the required stacks.

name: Divine Blessing
text: Divine Blessing | Complete the Gods gameplay to obtain levels, up to 3 level(s). Each level grants additional drop quantity to the Trial of the Gods.

name: Onslaught Automaton
text: Onslaught Automaton | When the Trial: God of Might begins, the Onslaught Automaton gains Invincibility and fires spinning lasers towards both ends. Once the Trial: God of Might reaches its Max Levels, the Onslaught Automaton's Invincibility ends. Defeating it thereafter drastically increases the trial's drop.

name: Lesser Statue of Machines
text: Lesser Statue of Machines | Lesser Statues of Machine are scattered at random locations within the trial area, each possessing additional drop rewards. Monsters will attack all Lesser Statues of Machine simultaneously. Rewards carried by each statue will be lost if it is destroyed. The damage a Lesser Statue of Machine can take is not affected by Netherrealm Talent Constellation.

name: Gods Gameplay
text: Gods Gameplay | The Gods gameplay includes Trial: God of War, Trial: God of Might, Trial: Goddess of Hunting, and Trial: God of Machines

name: Mini Cube of Rapacity
text: Mini Cube of Rapacity | Touching a Mini Cube of Rapacity has a chance to drop Desire Crystal, spawn a Fortuitous Malice Executor, or spawn a Cube Goblin that drops a large amount of Desire Crystals when defeated.

name: Giant Goblin
text: Giant Goblin | A Might Goblin is a special boss monster that has a chance to generate 1 additional Trial(s): God of Might nearby when defeated.

name: Mechanical Goblin
text: Mechanical Goblin | A Machine Goblin is a special boss monster that has a chance to generate 1 additional Trial(s): God of Machines nearby when defeated.

name: Doll Goblin
text: Doll Goblin | A Doll Goblin is a special boss monster that can drop 1 additional Cogwheel Voucher(s) when defeated.

name: Outlaw Goblin
text: Outlaw Goblin | An Outlaw Goblin is a special boss monster that has a chance to generate 1 additional TOWER Transport Vehicle(s) nearby when defeated.

name: Attack Aggression
text: Attack Aggression | Additionally increases Attack Speed and Attack Damage by 5%. Increases Movement Speed by 10%

name: Spell Aggression
text: Spell Aggression | Additionally increases Cast Speed and Spell Damage by 7%. Increases Mobility Skill Cooldown Recovery Speed by 7%

name: Frail
text: Frail | Additionally increases Spell Damage taken by 15%

name: Fire Infiltration
text: Fire Infiltration | Additionally increases Fire Damage taken by 13%. Reduces Skill Area by 8%

name: Cold Infiltration
text: Cold Infiltration | Additionally increases Cold Damage taken by 13%. Reduces Movement Speed by 5%

name: Lightning Infiltration
text: Lightning Infiltration | Additionally increases Lightning Damage taken by 13%. Reduces Attack Speed by 5%

name: Quickness
text: Quickness | Additionally increases Attack Speed, Cast Speed, Movement Speed, and Mobility Skill Cooldown Recovery Time by 8%

name: Fortitude
text: Fortitude | Each stack of Fortitude additionally reduces Hit Damage taken by 5% for 10s. / Base Max Fortitude Stacks: 3.

name: Torment
text: Torment | Each stack of Torment additionally increases Damage Over Time dealt by 5% for 4s. Stacks up to 3 times

name: Profane
text: Profane | Additionally increases Wilt and Deterioration Duration by 7%. Additionally increases Erosion Damage by 7% for 10s

name: Infiltration
text: Infiltration | Includes Cold Infiltration, Fire Infiltration, and Lightning Infiltration

name: Projectile Amplification
text: Projectile Amplification | +1.4% additional Projectile Damage per stack (multiplies) for 4s. Stacks up to 40 times

name: Fortify
text: Fortify | +5% Physique and +1% Max Elemental Resistance per stack for 8s. Stacks up to 10 times

name: Synergy Shift
text: Synergy Shift | -2% corresponding Resistance and +1% other Resistances for 4s when inflicting Fire/Cold/Lightning/Erosion Damage. Interval: 0.1s. Stacks up to 30 times

name: Elemental Infiltration
text: Elemental Infiltration | +50% additional Elemental Damage taken for 5s

name: Ill Will
text: Ill Will | -6% Erosion Resistance and +10% Elemental Resistance per stack for 4s. Stacks up to 8 times

name: Ashen Shroud
text: Ashen Shroud | Gained when Spiral Strike hits, lost when inflicting Ailments. Lasts 4s

name: Stealth
text: Stealth | +4% Movement Speed and +4% Mobility Skill Cooldown Recovery Speed per stack for 6s. Stacks up to 10 times

name: Ferocity
text: Ferocity | +10% additional Physical Damage and -3% additional damage taken. Physical Damage cannot be converted to other types.

name: Reverse Clock
text: Reverse Clock | Upon touch, increases the remaining time for current level

name: Severed Wing
text: Severed Wing | Upon touch, significantly increases Movement Speed, Attack and Cast Speed, and Mobility Skill Cooldown Recovery Speed for a period of time

name: Living Gun
text: Living Gun | Upon touch, fires ultra-high damage projectiles at nearby enemies for a period of time

name: Returning Anchor
text: Returning Anchor | Coordinates within the Overrealm. During exploration, you can teleport to these coordinates at any time

name: Max Levels
text: Max Levels | Filling the Containment Progress before the Overrealm expires grants a chance to open a door to a deeper level of the Overrealm. / After filling the Containment Progress of the Overrealm Level 4, you will face the Doorkeeper when time expires (Doorkeepers at Profound Timemark 8 or above have a chance to drop Special Prisms: Inverse Image).

name: Overrealm Disturbance: Fall
text: Overrealm Disturbance: Fall | At set intervals, the Overrealm rains down writhing tentacle clusters, dealing massive damage to the target area and spawning magical abnormalities with Additional Drop Quantity bonuses

name: Overrealm Disturbance: Resurrection
text: Overrealm Disturbance: Resurrection | Upon death, abnormalities within the Overrealm have a chance to spawn Normal abnormalities with Additional Drop Quantity bonuses

name: Overrealm Disturbance: Imprisonment
text: Overrealm Disturbance: Imprisonment | At set intervals, Rare abnormalities with Additional Drop Quantity bonuses will spawn near you

name: Floating Skull
text: Floating Skull | Abnormal Contained Objects carrying abundant drops and possessing extremely high Life. When defeated, they drop rare rewards and have a chance to revive

name: Antimemetic Cage
text: Antimemetic Cage | Upon touch, spawns an iron cage and several powerful Rare abnormalities carrying abundant drops around you. The cage only unlocks after all abnormalities are defeated

name: Doorhunter
text: Doorhunter | A hidden Boss abnormality in the Overrealm. Drops abundant rewards upon defeat

name: Bottled Shadow
text: Bottled Shadow | Contains a reward affix that increases drops in the Overrealm, lasting for one Overrealm round. Multiple reward affixes can stack for even richer loot / In the Overrealm at Timemark 4 or above, filling the Containment Progress guarantees a Bottled Shadow. Entering Level 3 or 4 of the Overrealm guarantees an additional Bottled Shadow.

name: Overrealm
text: Overrealm | A space accessible by passing through "Doors" in Netherrealm stages. It inherits the Timemark Bonuses, Netherrealm Resonance Bonuses, some Probes, Compasses, and Netherrealm Talent Bonuses from the Netherrealm stage it belongs to. / The drops in the Overrealm are not affected by any Pactspirits other than Overrealm Pactspirits

name: Overrealm Disturbance
text: Overrealm Disturbance | Includes Overrealm Disturbance: Resurrection, Overrealm Disturbance: Fall, and Overrealm Disturbance: Imprisonment

name: 3x3 Rectangle
text: 3x3 Rectangle | The Effect Area is an area expanded by the Prism, determining which Talents can be affected. / The Prism is located in the 2nd row, 2nd column within this Effect Area.

name: 3x4 Rectangle
text: 3x4 Rectangle | The Effect Area is an area expanded by the Prism, determining which Talents can be affected. / The Prism is located in the 2nd row, 2nd column within this Effect Area.

name: 4x3 Rectangle
text: 4x3 Rectangle | The Effect Area is an area expanded by the Prism, determining which Talents can be affected. / The Prism is located in the 2nd row, 2nd column within this Effect Area.

name: 2x2 Rectangle
text: 2x2 Rectangle | The Effect Area is an area expanded by the Prism, determining which Talents can be affected. / The Prism is located in the 1st row, 1st column within this Effect Area.

name: 7x1 Rectangle
text: 7x1 Rectangle | The Effect Area is an area expanded by the Prism, determining which Talents can be affected. / The Prism is located in the 1st row, 4th column within this Effect Area.

name: 2x4 Rectangle
text: 2x4 Rectangle | The Effect Area is an area expanded by the Prism, determining which Talents can be affected. / The Prism is located in the 2nd row, 1st column within this Effect Area.

name: 4x2 Rectangle
text: 4x2 Rectangle | The Effect Area is an area expanded by the Prism, determining which Talents can be affected. / The Prism is located in the 1st row, 2nd column within this Effect Area.

name: 1x1 Rectangle
text: 1x1 Rectangle | The Effect Area is an area expanded by the Prism, determining which Talents can be affected. / The Prism is located in the 1st row, 1st column within this Effect Area.

name: Doorkeeper
text: Doorkeeper | A Boss abnormality in the Overrealm. Has a chance to drop Inverse Image upon defeat

name: Temper
text: Temper | Affix values now roll within a dynamic random range, with their upper limit significantly increased. / [Micro Talent Effect Range: -100-200] / [Medium Talent Effect Range: -100-100] / [Legendary Medium Talent Effect Range: -100-50]

name: Mirror Reflection
text: Mirror Reflection | Mirror the Talent across the Talent Panel's center. If a Talent already exists in that position, its effect will be overwritten

name: Awakened
text: Awakened | When a monster awakens, its rarity changes, and it gains an Activity bonus based on its new rarity (Normal monsters +30 Activity, Magic monsters +60 Activity, Rare monsters and Bosses +120 Activity)

name: Replicate
text: Replicate | Add a group of monsters that are exact copies of the target in Name, Archetype, Rarity, Activity, and Quantity. / Active Mechanics: Addition, Replication

name: Mutation
text: Mutation | Transform the target monster into a group of monsters with a random Name, Archetype, and Rarity, while retaining the original Activity and Quantity / Active Mechanics: Mutation

name: Fuse
text: Fuse | Removes multiple monster groups and adds a new group whose Activity and Quantity are the sum of those removed. / Active Mechanics: Removal, Addition, Fusion

name: Devour
text: Devour | The target monster acts as a devourer, removing the devoured monsters and adding their Activity and Quantity to itself / Active Mechanics: Removal

name: Mutate into an Aemberon
text: Mutate into an Aemberon | Takes effect if the target monster Archetype is Aemberon

name: When adding a monster
text: When adding a monster | When adding a monster, this will not trigger if the Incubation Tank is full. Incubation Tank Upper Limit: 6

name: Antidote Vial
text: Antidote Vial | A treasure chest containing rewards obtained from the Vorax gameplay. The higher the Color Quality, the better the drops. During the Surgical Preparation phase, the higher your Ultimate Activity level, the better the corresponding Antidote Vial you'll obtain. In Shelley's Operating Theater, defeat a Vorax monster matching your Ultimate Activity level to unlock the corresponding Antidote Vial and claim your rewards.

name: Surgical Instrument
text: Surgical Instrument | Surgical Instruments are boost items obtained in the Vorax gameplay. They provide powerful special effects during the Preparation Phase, such as significantly increasing monster Quantity and Activity. They can also serve as core components for specific strategies, aiding you in training powerful Vorax monsters. In the Netherrealm, Surgical Instruments have a chance to drop when Vorax monsters are defeated. They can also be obtained when the Ultimate Activity reaches a certain level in the Surgical Preparation phase.

name: Incubation Elixir: Hollow Cocoon
